articles.title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.

articles.title_zh: Spool:混合远景-语言模型低密度流线推论
articles.content_zh: 视觉无障碍代理和机器人等应用需要快速地通过一个被限定的过去帧(如后两分钟)的窗口回答关于最近视频内容的问题. 混合视觉语言模型(VLMs)与Gated DeltaNet(GDN)等线性反复层相接而来,对这个设置具有吸引力,但保持一个滑动窗口却很昂贵. 原因是再生地层将所有过去的帧合并为一个共享状态,所以过期的旧帧通常需要通过模型重新运行整个窗口. 我们观察到,反复更新在状态下是带有投入依赖系数的同源物,因此可以捕捉到每个帧的效果,作为共成的转变. 我们提出Spool,一个免费的训练框架,它可以缓存每帧状态变换,并在窗口推进时高效地作曲,从每个经常层状态去掉过期的帧而无需通过主干重放帧. 每个层内部的清除是准确的;与注意钥匙价值的清除一样,过期的框架可以通过由更上一层计算出的缓存投入保留剩余影响。 我们设计了专用数据结构和GPU内核,以实现低缓存和高成份. 通过5个开源混合VLM和4个视频推理基准,斯普尔在所有20个模型基准测试中实现了最低的p95时间对先入为主,比最近的2个vLLM基线更快的几何平均值减少6.6\times$,同时将精度平均提高2.3个百分点.

articles.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
articles.content: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FastFrames: 互动空档的视频生成
articles.content_zh: 自动回转的视频传播模型基于新的观察和投入生成帧,使其成为互动视觉体验的有希望的媒介. 然而,现有的模型对于流体相互作用来说,数量级太慢了. 本文引入了FastFrames,一个由快自递式视频传播模型组成的家族,这些模型在不损害质量的情况下实现了互动性延缓. 我们剖析了最先进的模型的推论管道,并发现操作经常被作为固定执行细节处理,如VAE解码和KV缓存更新,事实上占了端到端推论延迟的一半以上. 我们对这些组成部分是不可或缺的假设提出质疑,并以轻量级替代品取而代之。 我们的1.3B变体运行在单个B200GPU上,每帧36ms,或每秒28个响应(RPS),同时匹配近8x慢的先进型号的生成质量. 我们的14B变体运行在一个8x B200 GPU节点上,每帧45ms,或22 RPS,并产生显著的更好的视觉质量和现实性. 我们显示 FastFrames 可以进行实时交互 应用,例如摄像机和物理设备的视频生成。

articles.title: EviSlide-MIL: Multi-Query Pooling and Shared Prediction for Class-Incremental Whole-Slide Image Classification
articles.content: Histopathological analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) plays a critical role in cancer diagnosis, and multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely adopted for WSI analysis under weak supervision. As new tumor subtypes are introduced, extending existing MIL models requires learning new classes while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. This presents a class-incremental learning challenge, where models must acquire new classes with limited access to historical training data and recognize all learned classes without task identifiers at inference. A major obstacle is forgetting, as updates to feature aggregation and prediction modules can degrade performance on previously learned classes. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{EviSlide-MIL}, a class-incremental WSI framework that integrates multiple learnable queries per class with a shared prediction module. The queries aggregate frozen patch features into class-specific representations, while the shared prediction module limits parameter growth across incremental stages. By freezing queries associated with previously learned classes, EviSlide-MIL preserves their attention patterns for identical inputs, while experience replay and knowledge distillation further mitigate forgetting as shared parameters are updated. Experiments on eight tumor subtypes from The Cancer Genome Atlas demonstrate that EviSlide-MIL achieves improved performance and reduced forgetting compared with competing methods across most learning settings, demonstrating its potential for scalable and knowledge-preserving WSI classification. Code and pretrained models will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EviSlide-MIL:分类-增量全滑图像分类的多查询集合和共享预测
articles.content_zh: 全滑成像(WSI)的病理学分析在癌症诊断中起关键作用,多例学习(MIL)在薄弱的监督下被广泛用于WSI分析. 随着新的肿瘤亚型被引入,扩展现有的MIL模型需要学习新的课程,同时保留以前学习过的知识. 这是一种班级递增的学习挑战,模型必须获得新的班级,但获取历史培训数据的机会有限,并承认所有学习班级没有任务识别符号。 一个主要障碍是忘记,因为对特征汇总和预测模块的更新会降低以往学习课程的性能。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出\textbf{EviSlide-MIL},一个班级递增的WSI框架,将每个班级的多个可学习的查询与一个共享的预测模块相融合. 查询汇总了被冻结的补丁功能,形成特定类的表示,而共享的预测模块则限制跨渐进阶段的参数增长. EviSlide-MIL通过冻结与以前学习过的课程有关的查询,保留了对相同输入的注意模式,而经验回放和知识分馏则随着共享参数的更新而进一步减轻了遗忘. 对来自"癌症基因组图集"的8个肿瘤亚型的实验表明,与大多数学习环境的相竞争方法相比,EviSlide-MIL实现了更好的性能并减少了遗忘,证明了其可扩展性和知识保存WSI分类的潜力. 代码和预训模型将发布.

articles.title: Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving
articles.content: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. We demonstrate how ID-MAE affords significant improvements in impairment inference results on both the DIVERT dataset and existing datasets, and enables strong results in additional tasks, such as trajectory and gaze prediction. For location-matched pairs, our model achieves a paired AUC of 0.706 for impairment detection on DIVERT, compared to 0.590 without reconstruction loss, improving over existing baselines. We probe the design space in terms of input modalities, masking scheme, positional encoding, attention mechanism, and decoding. We also investigate the interaction between various impairments in training and inference, demonstrating that visually demanding distractions are separable from cognitive distractions. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于模拟障碍驾驶的多式遮盖扩散自动编码器
articles.content_zh: 人类认知状态(如分心,压力),凝视,行为与驱动环境相互作用,其巧妙方式是AI可以用来帮助驱动器,但人类认知状态水平的地真相标签在规模上是昂贵的. 我们提出一个多模式的遮掩分解自编码器(ID-MAE),它增加了一个自我监督的缺陷预测目标:除了将被遮掩的缺陷标签预测为被遮掩的标志外,它还重建了被遮掩的目光和轨迹. 为了探究不同模式和类型缺陷对模型推论的影响,我们引入了DIVERT, 一个驱动模拟器数据集,包含103小时的驱动数据(n = 109),包含十种跨越认知、视觉和情感状态的缺陷诱导,并用凝视、车辆状态和场景视频记录。 我们证明了ID-MAE如何大大改进了DIVERT数据集和现有数据集的缺陷推论结果,并使得在轨迹和视线预测等额外任务方面能够取得强有力的成果。 对于位置相匹配的一对,我们的型号在DIVERT上实现了0.706的一对AUC来检测障碍,而0.590没有重建损失,比现有的基线有所改善. 我们从输入模式、掩码方案、位置编码、注意力机制以及解码等方面探索设计空间。 我们还调查培训和推论中各种缺陷之间的相互作用,表明视觉要求的分心与认知分心是分开的。 守则和数据一经接受即可提供。

articles.title: Learning Grounded Reasoning from Human Gaze
articles.content: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从"人类迷宫"学习理由
articles.content_zh: 人类视觉推理由系统探索和提取与任务相关的视觉证据所驱动. 人类的目光为这一过程提供了一个窗口,使目光成为视觉语言模型(VLMs)中以视觉为基础的推理的有用指导来源. 然而,人类的目光还包括噪音和冗余,这些噪音和冗余可能不良地转移到VLM上. 在这部作品中,我们调查如何有效地利用人视星等数据来改进VLMs中的视觉推理,同时保持与人类行为的一致性. 我们收集了7 109次人类目光试验 从一组多样而有挑战性的视觉推理任务, 并训练有不同形式目光指导的 基础推理模型。 在图表理解、视觉搜索和计数方面的评价中,我们发现,利用人类的目光作为有根据的推理的先导,始终比利用全部目光序列进行监督的要好。 基于这些调查结果,我们引入了GGR(Gaze-Guided Reasoner),实现了更大的人与人之间的对接和更加可靠的视觉地基定位,同时精确地匹配或优于领先的地基地基基线. 加强学习可进一步提高任务准确性、目视一致性和定位质量,尽管没有使用目视监督。 行为分析显示,在给出答案之前,被监视的模型表现出更多的视觉探索. 我们的结果显示,人类凝视的价值在于指导空间探索和塑造推理行为而不需要完全模仿人类行为.

articles.title: Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models
articles.content: We present a provably distortion-free semantic watermarking algorithm that requires only black-box sampling access to a generative model and black-box access to a semantic embedding. A watermark is called distortion-free if, averaged over its secret detection key, it leaves the generator's output distribution unchanged; this provides a formal guarantee that watermarking does not reduce output quality. Conventional such watermarks are often brittle to transformations. This is especially problematic for images, where benign operations such as compression, cropping, or resizing change the entire pixel representation. Semantic watermarks therefore require detection to be robust to content-preserving transformations. Previous methods combining these properties rely heavily on specific white-box properties of the underlying model: either to autoregressive text generation or to diffusion-specific access, such as control of the initial noise or diffusion inversion. In contrast, our construction is fully generic: It only interacts with the generative model and the semantic embedding, a function that determines the notion of "preserving content" under which detection should be robust, via sample and query access. We then instantiate this framework for image generation. We characterize the two competing properties required of the semantic embedding: it should remain stable under transformations that preserve an image's content, but should distinguish independent generations from the same prompt. We train an image encoder directly for this tradeoff. The resulting encoder improves separation while maintaining stability over off-the-shelf alternatives and enables strong aggregate detection while remaining robust to various transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our watermark scheme on both open-source and closed models, which is possible only due to restriction to black-box access.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 黑-狐狸基因模型的无语义水印
articles.content_zh: 我们提出了一个可以证明的无扭曲的语义标记水算法,它只需要黑盒采样访问基因模型和黑盒访问语义嵌入. 如果在它的秘密检测密钥上平均,使生成器的输出分布保持不变,那么一个水印就被称为无扭曲;这为水印不会降低输出质量提供了正式的保证. 这种传统的水印往往难以改变。 这对图像来说尤其有问题,在图像中,压缩,裁剪等良性操作或再大小改变整个像素代表. 因此,语义性水印要求检测对保存内容的转变具有强力。 以前结合这些属性的方法在很大程度上依赖于基础模型的特定白框属性:要么是自相递回的文本生成,要么是扩散特定的访问,如控制初始噪声或扩散倒置. 相反,我们的建筑是完全通用的: 它只与基因模型和语义嵌入相互作用,这个函数决定了"保留内容"的概念,在这个概念下检测应该很强,通过样本和查询访问. 然后,我们立即将这个框架用于图像生成。 我们描述语义嵌入所需的两种相竞属性:在保存图像内容的变相下,它应该保持稳定,但应该区分独立世代与同一瞬间. 我们直接为这个交易训练一个图像编码器。 由此产生的编码器改进了分离,同时保持了现成替代品的稳定性,并能够进行强聚检测,同时保持强能进行各种转换。 我们展示了我们的水印计划在开源和封闭模型上的有效性,这只有在限制黑箱访问的情况下才有可能.

articles.title: Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.

articles.title_zh: 场景国:未发现视野-语言模型中的安全故障
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以通过解释视觉事件提供有害的帮助,即使没有明确要求基本有害目标. 由375对图像问题组成, 跨越初始状态、中度状态、终极状态, 在8起自愿终止战斗中,现场状态投入得到有害的援助,攻击成功率为45.6-7.2.3%。 3个VLM的比较分析显示,场景状态输入最接近于其分层安全相关信号剖面中的QR相关图像,同时在生成过程中显示出较低的平均后层读取和鲜明的信号动态. 将有害目标转换成场景状态, 独立地询问图像-问题对, 在7个MM-Safety Bench类的8个开放重量和商用VLM中,S3TA实现了\textbf{71.2}的模型平均ASR,超过了最强基线6.1个百分点]. 文本侧过滤和视觉节制提供了有限的保护。 这些调查结果突出表明,除了筛选输入内容外,还需要通过现场推理来保障援助模式的推论。

articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. A separate leave-one-anatomy-out experiment tests parameter-free index extension: verified cases of an unseen solid organ enter the knowledge base, and the refiner stays frozen. A light shape-aware projection head on a frozen multimodal encoder maps embedding similarity to the shape agreement of the masks, so the knowledge base returns cases that the refiner can use as a shape prior. We evaluate GRACE on 18 public datasets spanning CT, MRI and ultrasound, using nine refinement configurations and seven upstream segmentors that span weak, mid, and strong operating regimes. We report each change with the DSC of its input mask. On the weak tier, the input DSC is 0.386 and GRACE adds up to +0.35 DSC. On a strong segmentor, the input DSC is 0.932 and the mean change is small. Transfer to an imaging modality that is absent from training and from the index is partial and depends on the anatomy, and remains an open research direction. Our results suggest retrieval-conditioned refinement is a practical alternative to anatomy-specific correction models. Code: https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace

articles.title_zh: 普通医学图像分解检索-强化校正
articles.content_zh: 自动化分解通常被作为以图像为基础的定量临床工作流程的第一步,其中预测的口罩随后由人类操作者审查并纠正. 剩余结构误差的自动校正目前一次处理一个解剖学问题,因此训练有素的校正器量与分化目标数量相仿. 我们介绍GRACE,这是一个检索增强的精炼器,在从已核实的先前案例共享知识库中提取的上下文下编辑一个输入口罩。 精炼者接受过一次关于多器官的训练,这些器官包括紧凑器官、腔道、分枝器和肿瘤损伤。 在被搁置的数据集传输评价中,三个被搁置的数据集查询了仅从培训数据中建立的固定知识库。 单独放行一解剖实验测试参数无索引扩展:已核实的未见固体器官病例进入知识库,精炼者会被冻结. 在被冻结的多式编码器地图上以浅色的形状感知投影头嵌入了与口罩的形状协议相类似之处,因此知识库会返回炼油器可以用作形状的前作的大小写. 我们利用9个精密配置和7个上游分路器,对覆盖CT、核磁共振和超声波的18个公共数据集进行评估,它们跨越薄弱、中和强大的操作系统。 我们用DSC的输入口罩报告每个变化. 在弱层,输入DSC为0.386,GRACE加起来为+0.35 DSC. 在强分管上,输入DSC为0.932,平均变化为小分管. 向没有参加培训和指数的成像模式转移是部分的,取决于解剖学,仍然是开放的研究方向。 我们的结果显示,有检索条件的完善是解剖学特定校正模型的实用替代. 代码:https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: Any2Building: Unifying Point Clouds and Images for Building Reconstruction via Shared Spatial Queries
articles.content: Abstracting structured buildings from limited observations is essential for 3D urban modeling and digital twins. Partial point clouds and overhead images of the same building provide incomplete 3D surface measurements and visual cues to its footprint, roof geometry, and rooftop structures, respectively. This motivates a unified framework that aligns geometric and visual cues in 3D and reconstructs buildings from either or both modalities. Building on this connection, we present Any2Building, a unified model for Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building reconstruction from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both, with optional coarse geometric priors. At its core is an occupancy-grounded shared spatial queries representation that organizes available observations within a common 3D grid. Supervised by complete building surface voxels, these queries connect observational evidence to target geometry, enabling a shared generator to learn structural priors across tasks and providing spatial guidance for recovering missing structure. A trained voxel conditional surface-generation and low-poly remeshing pipeline then converts the predicted structure into compact LoD2 building models. To support this framework, we introduce BuildingWorld-Image, comprising approximately one million paired samples of partial point clouds, overhead images, and LoD2 building models across 18 cities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Any2Building outperforms existing methods in geometric reconstruction accuracy across unimodal and multimodal point-cloud completion, single-image building generation, and prior-assisted generation, while maintaining detailed and robust recovery when point cloud input modality is degraded.

articles.title_zh: Any2 建筑 : 通过共享空间查询统一建筑重建点云和图像
articles.content_zh: 将结构化的建筑物从有限的观测中抽取出来,对于3D城市建模和数码双胞胎至关重要. 同一建筑物的部分点云和上层图像分别提供了不完整的三维地表测量和足迹、屋顶几何和屋顶结构的视觉提示。 这推动了统一框架,使3D中的几何和视觉提示一致,并从其中一种或两种模式重建建筑物。 在这个连接的基础上,我们提出Any2 Construction,一种从部分点云来进行建筑重建(LOD2)的统一模型,上面的图像,或者两者兼有,带有可选的粗几何前缀. 其核心是以占用为基础的共享空间查询代表,在共同的3D网格内组织可用的观测. 这些查询由完整的建筑地表活塞监督,将观测证据连接到目标几何,使一个共享的生成器能够学习跨任务的结构前科,并为恢复缺失的结构提供空间指导. 一个训练有素的Voxel有条件地表生成和低孔重熔管再将所预测的结构转换为紧凑的LoD2建筑模型. 为支持这一框架,我们引入了“建筑世界-图像”,包括大约一百万对部分点云样本、高架图像和LOD2建筑模型,覆盖了18个城市。 对多种基准的实验表明,Any2 Construction在几何重建精确度方面超越了现有的方法,跨越了单式和多式点-云完成、单相构筑物生成和前相辅助生成,同时在点云输入模式退化时保持了详细而强劲的恢复。

articles.title: Say Less, Hallucinate Less? Diagnosing and Restoring Object Coverage in Preference-Optimized Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Preference optimization (PO) is the standard way to reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models. We find that four public PO checkpoints of LLaVA-1.5-7B also lower object coverage. They name fewer object categories, and their lower hallucination rates bring no significant gain in set-level object F1 on CHAIR. We therefore ask how much of the PO gain the base model can reproduce by stopping earlier. A positive end-of-sequence (EOS) logit bias lets the base model reach the recall of each PO model, and this early stopping alone reproduces 58 to 86 percent of the CHAIRi gain of three checkpoints on two disjoint COCO sets. Writing longer does not bring the lost categories back. Under greedy decoding, a negative EOS bias recovers only 2 to 9 percent of the lost CHAIR recall of these checkpoints, and 94 to 96 percent of the added object mentions repeat categories already named. On CHAIR, the base caption of the same image still names about half of the missed object categories. We therefore propose base-guided object-category restoration, which appends high-confidence base-only categories to the PO caption without training. With thresholds fixed on a development set, it brings three checkpoints within one point of the base recall on a held-out COCO set with a lower distinct-object hallucination rate than the base model. Against the recall-matched base stopping curve, its gain holds for RLAIF-V near the base recall and for RLAIF-V and CHAIR-DPO at an intermediate recall. We will release the code of the recall-controlled evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 少说点,幻觉少说点? 优待-优待-优待-优待模式中的诊断和恢复对象覆盖面
articles.content_zh: 偏好优化(PO)是在大型视觉语言模型中减少对象幻觉的标准方法. 我们认为,LLaVA-1.5-7B的四个公共PO检查站也降低了物体的覆盖范围。 它们命名对象类别较少,而其较低的幻觉率在CHAIR上的设定级对象F1没有显著收益. 因此,我们询问PO有多少通过更早的停止而获得了基础模型的复制. 一个积极的末端记录(EOS)的偏差让基本模式达到了每个PO模式的召回,而这个早期的停止单是重复了两个不相连的COCO集上三个检查站的58%至86%的CHAIRi收益. 写得更长不会使丢失的类别恢复. 在贪婪的解码下,负面的EOS偏好只恢复了这些检查站失落的CHAIR召回量的2%至9%,94%至96%的新增对象提到已经命名的重复类别. 在CHAIR上,同一图像的底标题仍然取出大约一半被忽略对象类别的名称. 因此,我们提议恢复基准指导对象类别,在不经过培训的情况下,将高度信任基础类别附加到PO标题中。 由于在一组发展装置上设定了阈值,因此在基地召回点的一分之内,将三个检查站放在一个被搁置的COCO上,其明显物体幻觉率低于基准模型。 与回扣相匹配的基站曲线相比,其在基站回扣附近的RLAIF-V以及中间回扣上的RLAIF-V和CHAIR-DPO的收益。 我们将发布召回控制评估的代码。

articles.title: Déjà View: A Shared Working-Memory Model for Visual Tasks
articles.content: A working-memory model must remember stimuli and use its memory flexibly to perform different tasks. Here we introduce a model of working memory for images that combines dynamic activity with temporary associations between image features. We train the model on five tasks, including remembering a sample while other images are presented, categorizing distractor images while remembering the sample, and determining whether an image is new or has been presented before. The same trained model performs all tasks, guided by explicit cues about which response is required. We use this flexible memory model to ask how delay, distraction, and image history affect performance. Delays have little effect on sample-memory performance for the delays we tested, while seeing more images leads to more false alarms even when the target image appeared equally recently in all cases. On the sample-memory-plus-categorization task, the probability of correct responses on all questions decreases as more questions are asked, despite robust sample-memory performance. Finally, the model maintains stable performance across 40 brief trials of each task under the tested conditions. Together, these results demonstrate how a single working-memory system can be flexibly used to perform different tasks, and how its errors depend on both previous images and task demands.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Déjà View: 视觉任务的共享工作记忆模型
articles.content_zh: 工作记忆模型必须记住刺激,并灵活地利用其记忆来完成不同的任务. 在这里,我们引入了一个图像工作记忆模型,将动态活性与图像特征之间的临时关联结合起来. 我们根据五项任务来训练模型,包括在展示其他图像的同时记住一个样本,在记住样本的同时对分心者图像进行分类,以及确定一个图像是新图像还是之前呈现过的. 同样的训练有素的模式执行所有任务,以明确的指示为指导,需要做出何种反应。 我们用这个灵活的记忆模型来询问延迟,分心,图像历史如何影响性能. 延迟对我们测试的延迟的样本-记忆性能影响不大,同时看到更多的图像会导致更多的假警报,即使目标图像在所有情况下最近都同样出现. 在样本-记忆-加-分类任务上,对所有问题的正确答复概率会随着更多的问题的提出而降低,尽管样本-记忆性表现强劲. 最后,该模型在试验条件下对每项任务的40个简短审判中保持了稳定的业绩。 这些结果共同显示了一个单一的工作-记忆系统如何能够灵活地用于执行不同的任务,以及它的错误如何取决于以前的图像和任务要求.

articles.title: Attribution Through the Decoder: Prediction-Space Explanations for Structured Outputs
articles.content: Networks that predict angles, gaze directions, and rotations do not output these quantities directly: they emit raw coordinates that a fixed decoder, such as normalization, maps to the final prediction. Attribution methods are usually applied to the raw coordinates, so they can credit inputs for changes the decoder discards, such as rescaling a vector when only its direction matters. The resulting explanation can highlight inputs that have no effect on the prediction. We instead attribute through the decoder differential, which for normalization decoders reduces to a scaled tangent projection. We characterize invariance to output rescaling, show that every fixed smooth scalar target on a sphere has points of zero tangential sensitivity, and show that an endpoint-projected variant of Integrated Gradients can still attribute to scale-only inputs, whereas direct angular Integrated Gradients cannot. On synthetic tasks with analytically known relevance, ambient attribution assigns up to 72% of its mass to an irrelevant region. On MPIIGaze validation data, tangent Grad-CAM produces 44% greater prediction displacement under 10% pixel deletion. On PASCAL3D+ with a 6D rotation decoder, the full differential improves mean deletion displacement by 14.1 degrees over the ambient coordinate sum and by 13.8 degrees over a decoder-invariant scalar. Results for a two-polarity tangent LayerCAM variant are mixed: it exceeds ambient-sum LayerCAM on circular regression but no difference is detected on quaternion pose. These results separate two failure sources, radial contamination and scalarization loss. The approach uses existing attribution methods with decoder-aware targets, although some variants also require changes to attribution aggregation. An invariant attribution can still miss inputs that drive the prediction, so invariance and deletion performance should each be checked.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过编码器进行分配:结构化产出的预测空间解释
articles.content_zh: 预测角度,凝视方向和旋转的网络不会直接输出出这些量:它们发出原始坐标,即一个固定的解码器,如正常化,映射到最终预测. 归宿法通常被应用于原始坐标上,因此它们可以将去解码器丢弃物的改变记入入入内,例如当一个矢量只有它的方向关系时,会重新缩放. 由此产生的解释可以突出对预测没有影响的投入. 相反,我们通过解码器的差分来进行属性分析,对于正常化解码器来说,这种差分将缩小成正切投影。 我们定性为偏移输出回缩,显示一个球上每个固定平滑平滑的平滑平滑目标都具有零微分灵敏度,并显示集成梯度(Integrated Gradients)的一个端点所预测的变体仍然可以归属于只缩放输入,而直接角集成梯度则不能. 就具有分析上已知相关性的合成任务而言,环境归属将高达其质量的72%分配给一个无关的区域。 在MPIIGaze验证数据上,正切Grad-CAM在10%像素删除下产生44%更大的预测移位. 在带有6D自转分解码器的PASCAL3D+上,全相差改善意味着删除移位在环境坐标和上相差为14.1度,而去相差为13.8度。 两极切合层CAM变体的结果有好有坏:循环回归时超过环境-和层CAM,但在四角体外观上没有发现差异。 这些结果分离出两个出故障源:射线污染和分级损失. 这种方法采用现有的具有解码器-意识目标的归属方法,尽管一些变体还要求改变归属汇总. 一个变化无常的归属仍然会错过驱动预测的输入,因此,每个输入和删除的性能都应该被检查.

articles.title: TextSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity
articles.content: Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. We incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that jointly promotes semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate that TextSphere consistently reduces generation FID (gFID) over the text-conditioned baseline while achieving reconstruction FID (rFID) below 1.0. With only 4 and 6 sampling steps, TextSphere achieves lower gFID than the compared diffusion- and GAN-based models trained from scratch on CUB-200-2011 and MS-COCO-2014, respectively. We further observe that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily yield better generation quality. In addition, we use Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) to analyze cross-modal alignment and modality gap, offering insight into the effectiveness of our approach.

articles.title_zh: 文本层:通过共享的超球面对齐和统一生成高效文本到图像
articles.content_zh: 最近在文字到图像生成方面的进展大大提高了图像质量,特别是通过传播方法,这些方法需要多个推论步骤。 相形之下, Sphere Encoder提供了一个高效的基因框架,能够以更少的前进步骤生成图像. 然而,将其扩展至自由式文本是非三角性的,因为它的类条件设计缺乏跨模式对接. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用文本圈(TextSphere),这是一个高效的文本到图像分源框架,将Sphere Encoder扩展为语言条件和跨模式相接. 我们通过适应地层常态化(AdaLN)嵌入经过预先训练的CLIP文本来指导图像生成,同时保留了原始的球形采样机制. 为了弥合跨模式代表差距,我们提出了球形语义一致和统一的目标,共同促进超层语义一致和代表统一。 关于CUB-200-2011、MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k的实验表明,TextSphere持续地将FID(gFID)的生成量降低于文本条件基准,同时实现重建FID(rFID)低于1.0. 由于只有4个和6个取样步骤,TextSphere的GFID低于分别从零开始在CUB-200-2011和MS-COCO-2014上培训的基于传播和GAN的模型。 我们进一步注意到,改善重建忠心不一定产生更好的发电质量。 此外,我们使用部分最不平面 Singular Value分解(PLS-SVD)来分析跨模式对接和模式差距,为我们的方法的有效性提供了深刻的见解.

articles.title: VIVID: Beyond Static Multi-Image Reasoning with Localized Visual Differences and Textual Entity Dynamics in Video MLLMs
articles.content: Video question answering under tight frame budgets requires preserving localized motion and event order, yet current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reduce comprehension to static multi-image reasoning by discarding unselected frames and encoding keyframes independently: (1) Spatially, whole-frame pooling dilutes small moving targets into static backgrounds; (2) Temporally, dropping intermediate frames or averaging tokens erases inter-frame motion, confusing direction, speed, and order. We propose VIVID (Visual Inter-frame Variations and Individual Dynamics), which moves beyond static snapshots like human vision: keyframes capture core states while inter-frame Patch Diffs preserve neighboring changes within $K_f$ keyframes. Autonomous Delta-Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) selects anchors from a $3\text{ fps}$ pool and feeds surrounding patch differences into Dual-Road Change Memory (DRCM), forming Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside a camera-stabilized Active Motion Region of Interest (ROI) and chronological Entity State Chains. Adding $0.22\%$ trainable parameters to a frozen $27\text{B}$ backbone, VIVID-Small ($50$ examples, $\sim 1.5$ GPU hours) beats all eleven baselines in overall accuracy across $8,083$ questions and trails only VIVID-Large ($3,600$ examples), which leads on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VIVID:在视频 MLLMs中,超越静态多图像与局部视觉差异和文字实体动态的理性
articles.content_zh: 在紧凑的框架预算下回答视频问题需要保留局部运动和事件顺序,然而目前的视频多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)却通过独立丢弃未选择的框架和编码密钥框架来降低对静态多图像推理的理解: (1)在空间上,全帧集合会稀释小移动目标入静态背景; (2)暂时地,抛出中间相框或平均相标会抹去相框间运动,使方向,速度,秩序混乱. 我们提出VIVID(视觉跨框架变化和个人动态),它超越了像人类视觉那样的静态快照:键框捕捉到核心状态,而相框Patch Diffs在$K_f$键框内保存相邻的变化. 自主 Delta-Driven 密钥帧规划(ADKP)从 3\text{ fps}$ 池中选择主锚,并将周围的补丁差异反馈到双路变化内存(DRCM)中,与相机稳定的活动兴趣区(ROI)和时间顺序实体国链一起以零额外锚值组成动态托肯斯. VIVID-Small(50美元的例子,1.5美元GPU小时)将0.22美元可训练参数加到一个被冻结的27\text{B}$的主干线上,在8,083美元的问题中以总体准确度击败了所有11个基线,并且只有VIVID-Large(3,600美元的例子),这导致了Motion Bench、Video-MME和TempCompass。

articles.title: $π^4$: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
articles.content: $π^4$ is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, $π^4$ achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 4美元:4D场景几何和运动的基础模型
articles.content_zh: $π^4$是4D场景感知的统一地基模型. 从野生-一单相图,无序相集,或相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 它将一个几何分行与一个几何条件的运动分行相配,该分行利用重建后的目标-视野几何来预测被提升为3D的图像-空间对应. 在各种基准中,4美元在几何评价方面达到最佳的总体平均排名,同时在单视和多视2D/3D分点跟踪和移动对象分取方面的竞争表现。 有了共享的骨干,完整的几何和运动系统包含大约0.5B参数-小于大多数基线大小的一半. 它在一个前行通道上产生联合重建和轨道,包括大规模场景,尽管经过培训,最多有64个观点,但有上千个输入图像。 我们进一步介绍了这些能力所依据的数据和培训方法,以及对关键设计选择的经验研究。 代码和模型见https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4。

articles.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
articles.content: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TCP4D:机器人操纵统一工具中心跟踪和生成模型
articles.content_zh: 机器人操纵视频提供了丰富的视觉体验,然而从RGB观测中恢复机器人动作和抓取状态说明仍然具有挑战性. 利用"能化-不可化-工具-中心-点"(TCP)作为动作空间,我们提出"TCP4D",这是一种统一的模型,其中共享的4D场景代表器既能观测到TCP运动,又能生成未来的TCP出轨. 由于一个单相机视频和初始的2D TCP查询,跟踪器直接回收了SE(3)中标定的TCP平面,并和场景几何和相机参数并列的抓取状态. 生成器在回收的TCP轨迹上从相同的4D代表物中抽取出局部特征,再与机器人观测和语言指令结合来预测未来的TCP状态. 我们新的交叉化增强管道将现有的RGB视频转换为演示,通过重新瞄准回收的运动和合成相应的观测结果,而不记录源-机器人状态。 实验显示,跟踪器在DROID和RoboLab上实现了7.60和16.07毫米的绝对轨迹误差,并适应了只有10个演示的新化身. 发电机在RoboTwin上取得了69.19%的成功,并在两项现实世界任务上超越了既定的政策模式,而关于源头的联合培训和扩大的示范则使目标机器人的成功率比扩大的唯一培训提高了41.5%。

articles.title: GameRealm: Grounding Visual Learning in Interactive Games
articles.content: Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale, richly annotated dataset that grounds visual observations in synchronized, game-native supervision. GameRealm encompasses over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay footage across all views. Beyond its unprecedented scale, GameRealm provides rich multimodal supervision, including metric depth, camera parameters, synchronized audio, control inputs, and 3D point trajectories. Its diversity further extends to flexible view configurations, spanning single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic recordings. To enable scalable acquisition across diverse game environments, we develop a unified data collection pipeline that combines human-operated interaction with agentic exploration. Extensive experiments across diverse visual learning tasks demonstrate that GameRealm consistently strengthens visual foundation models in both visual generation and geometric learning. These results establish GameRealm as a versatile and valuable data resource, unlocking new opportunities for advancing visual intelligence.

articles.title_zh: GameRealm: 互动游戏中的地平面视觉学习
articles.content_zh: 视觉基础模型是物理智能的核心,但其发展仍然受到零散的培训数据集、不一致的注释质量和有限的多模式监督的限制。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了GameRealm,这是一个大规模,内容丰富的注解数据集,将视觉观测作为同步,游戏本土监督的基础. GameRealm包含超过1.2亿个RGB帧和1000小时的游戏播放镜头,覆盖了所有视图. 除了其前所未有的规模之外,GameRealm还提供了丰富的多模式监督,包括度量深度,相机参数,同步音频,控制输入,和3D点轨迹等. 它的多样性进一步扩展到了灵活的取景配置,包括了单取景,立体声,多取景,和全景录音. 为了能够在不同的游戏环境中实现可扩展的获取,我们开发了统一的数据收集管道,将人类操作的互动与代理探索结合起来. 跨越各种视觉学习任务的广泛实验表明,GameRealm在视觉生成和几何学习中都持续地加强视觉基础模型. 这些成果将GameRealm确立为多能和有价值的数据资源,为推进视觉智能打开了新的机遇.

articles.title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.

articles.title_zh: 地平线的幻想:视线-语言模型是否像理想观察者一样维吾检索文字和图像?.
articles.content_zh: 被检索到的视觉语言模型(VLM)从两个证据来源中解答,每个证据都可能失败:被检索到的文本可能错误或吵闹,图像也可能被退化或相矛盾. 我们引入了由COCO和Visual Genome所制造的GIB-200K,20万个图像问题项目,每个项目都扩展为可控的压力条件:硬负回取噪(1-20个文档),视觉模糊(Gausian and Movement 模糊,低资源收成)和与反事实翻转对对的交叉模式冲突. 我们不但要衡量退化,还要问模型如何将两种模式结合起来。 从理想的贝叶斯提示组合中,我们得出了一种可测试的预测,该预测得出了"知识内线"(相对于模型自身图像证据的文本超重)和"感官捕捉"(反相)的正式定义,我们用一个测量-过重校正的回归来估计重量,我们验证了这些回归的已知重量的恢复。 反事实翻转分解将模式偏差与概念前缀区分开来,并用地平线幻觉分数来测量图像中有多少干净的精度没有根基. 我们评价一个冷冻的4个开放式模型, 种子评价分为2 000个GIB-200K项目。 所有模型在清洁输入上都是准确的(92.5%-94.2%),但反准确率下降到41.3%-59.9%. LLaVA的两个模型超重了文本(Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229和1.322),而InternVL3偏好图像(w_T/w_I = 0.680);在文档存在时,34.8%到71.4%的正确答案被废弃. 无培训一致性检查,将答案与不检索的答案进行比较,在误导性文件下进行准确性覆盖,而当图像严重退化时,返回图像失败。 发布所有每一次输入输出,代码,以及重新计算每个已报告的开放型号的审计.

articles.title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
articles.content: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.

articles.title_zh: Nunchi:多党对话中的耳朵帮助眼睛
articles.content_zh: 确定一个人看谁对理解多党对话至关重要,然而,随着更多的人出现,仅仅看几何就变得模糊不清。 对话提供了几何学缺乏的提示,例如谁在说话和所说的话,但是没有央视数据集为许多多党派场景提供. 我们引入了SORBET,从1,578个有同步语音,文字记录的片段中取出3,340个样本的基准,以及出席的人物标签,覆盖的多党场景比现有的央视数据集还要多. 先前的凝视模型在努力使用这些以不同形式出现的提示时,必须和合适的人联系起来,并且可以与凝视几何相冲突. 我们提议Nunchi这个框架从文字记录和央视和扬声器模型的输出中构建出一个文本提示,将每个提示与候选人连接到共同的标签上,并让一个视觉语言模型(VLM)将央视几何与对话提示进行权衡,以识别受访者。 Nunchi的成绩比现有最强的方法高出4.8个百分点。 在SORBET上,对话提示有帮助,而额外视觉提示则无所助益,收益则贯穿三个VLM,并带有自动记录誊本,以及两个现有的数据集.

articles.title: LUTBench: Benchmarking Text-Driven Photographic Look Transfer
articles.content: Photographic color grading shapes the tone and color of a photograph to achieve a desired look. Text-driven photographic look transfer lets users specify these adjustments in natural language, with the goal of reproducing the requested look across photographs while preserving their content. However, prior research on text-driven color grading uses different datasets, text instructions, target definitions, and metrics. These differences make it difficult to compare how faithfully the methods reproduce the same look. To compare methods under a shared protocol, we introduce LUTBench. We collect 91 three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) and define one photographic look per LUT with a specified input conversion. Applying these looks to 5,000 MIT-Adobe FiveK photographs produces 455,000 input-target image pairs with reproducible target images. For each look, we use templates to turn measured tone and color changes on fixed color samples into candidate clauses. We use training image measurements to verify applicable clauses before composing the text description. The evaluation measures target fidelity, tests sensitivity to predefined input conversions, and separates generalization to unseen looks from reproduction of seen looks on new photographs. Across 16 methods, stronger text alignment does not guarantee target fidelity. However, most supervised variants improve fidelity on both seen and unseen looks.

articles.content_zh: 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 由文字驱动的相片外观传输让用户用自然语言来指定这些调整,目的是在保存照片内容的同时复制所请求的相片. 然而,之前对文本驱动的颜色分级的研究使用不同的数据集,文本指令,目标定义,和度量衡. 这些差异使得难以比较这些方法如何忠实地复制同样的外观. 为了比较共享协议下的方法,我们引入了LUT Bench. 我们收集了91个三维取景表(3D LUT),并定义了每个LUT一个有指定输入转换的相片取景. 把这些外观应用到5000张MIT-Adobe FiveK相片中,会产生455,000个输入-目标图像对并有可复制的目标图像. 对于每种外观,我们使用模板将固定颜色样本上测量到的调和颜色变化转化为候选条款. 我们使用培训图像测量方法,在形成文字描述之前核查适用条款。 评价措施以忠诚为目标,测试对预先定义的输入转换的敏感性,并将一般化到看不见的外观与复制新相片上的所见外观分开。 在16个方法中,文本更加一致并不能保证目标忠实。 然而,大多数受监督的变体提高了外表和外表的忠诚度。

articles.title: Event-Based Dynamic Lip Region Estimation During Speech
articles.content:
Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low power consumption, making them promising for speech-related applications. These include automatic lip reading, audiovisual speech analysis, and human-robot interaction, particularly in challenging environments characterized by low illumination or high dynamic range. Event-based lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection, however, mostly operate on a cropped region of interest (ROI), by hand or by the dataset, and no event-based method supplies that ROI as a spatial region; existing event-based face analysis gives the mouth as landmarks, which presents a mismatch between application and localization. The present work predicts a dense heatmap over the lip region from the full event "frame". Events are encoded as a polarity-separated voxel grid and processed at every location by a two-pathway continuous-time recurrent network (CT-RNN) with learned, log-space bounded time constants acting on the real elapsed time of each bin: a stateless fast pathway and a stateful slow pathway, utilised for refining and anchoring the prediction. The model reaches 69.5% on lips on four unseen speakers and switches target only 2.1 times per second, against 8.9 and 11.0 for convolutional baselines with
  more parameters. Adding a spatial encoder improves precision but fails on a new face scale. On a real event sensor, trained only on simulated events, the proposed model reaches 58.0% on lips against 43.2% for the CNN, with fewer than half its target switches.

articles.title_zh: 发言期间基于事件的动态唇区估计
articles.content_zh:
事件相机能提供高时间分辨率和低功耗,使其对语音相关应用有希望. 其中包括自发读唇、视听语音分析和人与机器人的互动,特别是在低照明或高动态范围的挑战环境中。 然而,基于事件的唇读取,扬声器识别,和语音活性检测,大多在被收割的受关注区域(ROI)通过人工或数据集运行,没有基于事件的方法提供ROI作为空间区域;以事件为主的现有相貌分析给出了口作为地标,这呈现出应用和本地化之间的不匹配. 目前的工作预测从整个事件"框架"中,唇区域上空出现密集热图. 事件被编码为极相分离的阴道网格,并在每个地点由一个双向连续的经常性网络(CT-RNN)处理,其中有经过学习的、有日志的、有界限的时间常数按每个垃圾箱实际经过的时间行事:一个无国籍的快道和一个状态缓慢的路径,用于精炼和锁定预测。 该模型在4个隐形扬声器上在唇上达到69.5%,每秒切换目标只有2.1次,而其中8.9次和11.0次为转动基线。
更多的参数。 添加空间编码器可以提高精度,但在新的面额尺度上失败. 在真实事件传感器上,只接受模拟事件的培训,拟议模型的唇能达到58.0%,而CNN的则达到43.2%,其目标开关不到一半.

articles.title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
articles.content: Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. We introduce FMT (Fixed-step Multiscale Tree), a lossless image format whose decoding order and entropy coder are designed together so that neither wait grows with the image. FMT stores an image as a coarse-to-fine tree whose steps hold independent values: a GPU predicts each step at once and decodes it in parallel rANS lanes that carry their states from step to step, so an image of any size decodes in a fixed number of sequential steps. On this tree we build a family of bit-exact codecs, from a rule with no network to large networks, and no codec we ran on the same GPU beats any of them on both size and speed. Without a network, FMT beats NVIDIA's HTJ2K on size and speed; with a large one, it decodes Kodak photos 9 to 61X faster than learned codecs we ran on the same A100, at the same size or smaller.

articles.title_zh: FMT: 固定的平行步骤中的无损失图像压缩
articles.content_zh: 所学的无损失解码器比普通的古典解码器要小,然而我们归档和训练的图像仍然使用古典解码器. 一个主要原因是时间:一个被学习的解码器需要几秒钟才能解码出一个以毫秒为单位打开的古典解码器相片,而他们的更快的变体放弃了大部分的大小收益. 我们争论说,这大部分时间都是在等待,而不是计算:网络在等待它所附带的值,算术解码器一次读一次. 我们引入了FMT(Fixed-step-Multiscale Tree),这是一种无损失的图像格式,其解码顺序和 en码器是一起设计的,这样两个等都无法与图像一起生长. FMT以粗对细树的形式存储一幅图像,其步骤具有独立的值:一个GPU一次预测每一步,并用平行的RANS道来解码,将状态从步到步相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相相接相 在这个树上,我们构建了一个比特精确的解码器家族,从一个没有网络的规则到大型网络,没有一个解码器我们运行在同一个GPU上,在大小和速度上都比他们中任何一个都要快. 没有了网络,FMT在大小和速度上击败了NVIDIA的HTJ2K;用一个大块来解码柯达克相片9至61X的速度比我们在同一A100上运行的已学到的编码器要快,大小相同或较小.

articles.title: Event-Based Person Detection for Maritime UAV Search
articles.content: Maritime search and rescue requires locating people in the water quickly, motivating the use of UAVs to survey the search area. During flight, camera motion and the longer exposures used in low light can blur small targets and hinder person detection. Event cameras record brightness changes as they occur, reducing the motion blur associated with longer exposure times. We investigate their use for maritime person detection by generating synthetic events using the v2e event simulator from public MOBDrone rescue videos and retaining the existing annotations. We compare the recurrent vision transformer model RVT-T with YOLOv8n and RT-DETR-R18 trained on exposure-matched images. On 843 test samples from held-out recordings, RVT-T achieves 15.63% person AP50:95, compared with 6.89% for YOLOv8n and 9.44% for RT-DETR-R18 under 100 ms synthetic exposure. Increasing exposure times from 50 to 200 ms progressively reduces frame-based detection accuracy, widening the gap to the event model. To evaluate the feasibility of on-board processing, we deploy our detector on a Jetson Orin Nano platform. The RVT-T model retains its accuracy and requires approximately 136 ms and 2.02 J per sample, allowing real-time processing on the UAV.

articles.title_zh: 海上无人驾驶航空器搜索事件调查人员
articles.content_zh: 海上搜索和救援要求迅速将人员放入水中,促使使用无人驾驶航空器来勘测搜索区域. 在飞行期间,相机运动和低光下使用的更长时间的暴露会模糊小目标并阻碍人探测. 事件相机记录亮度随发生而变化,减少与更长时间的曝光时间相关的运动模糊. 我们通过使用公共MOBDrone救援视频的v2e事件模拟器生成合成事件,并保留现有的说明,来调查它们用于海上人探测. 我们把反复出现的视觉变压器型号RVT-T与YOLOv8n和RT-DETR-R18进行了关于曝光相匹配图像的培训相提并论. 在843个来自被扣留录音的试验样本中,RVT-T达到15.63%的人AP50:95,而YOLOv8n为6.89%,RT-DETR-R18为9.44%,低于100毫秒的合成接触。 曝光时间从50至200米逐渐降低帧检测精度,与事件模型的差距也随之扩大. 为了评估机载处理的可行性,我们在杰特森·奥林·纳诺平台上部署探测器. RVT-T型机车保持了准确性,每台样机需要约136ms和2.02J,允许在无人机上实时处理.

articles.title: Transfer Once, Ask Locally: Compact Audio-Visual Memory for On-Device Question Answering
articles.content: Audio-visual question answering on lightweight user devices requires balancing speed, memory usage, privacy, and communication. One approach is to run audio-visual encoders on a server and a lightweight language decoder on the user device, keeping questions local while offloading media encoding. However, transferring and processing the full multimodal representation remains costly. We propose a training-free, query-agnostic token pruning framework that constructs a compact, reusable memory before transmission. We define video spatio-temporal blocks and aligned audio windows as players and estimate their importance through Monte Carlo Shapley valuation. We use an embedding coverage objective that combines query-independent utility with cross-modal redundancy calibration and rewards unimodal diversity through marginal coverage gains. We retain the original token embeddings of high-scoring players under a limited token budget and transfer the resulting memory once for reuse across subsequent local questions. Experiments on Video-MME, Daily-Omni, and Video-Holmes using video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) and video-SALMONN 2 Pro (4B) show that our method achieves the best or tied-best QA accuracy among the compared compression methods across all evaluated settings. On Daily-Omni with video-SALMONN 2+ (3B) at 80\% pruning, our method improves accuracy by 12.86--14.62 percentage points over these methods while achieving the lowest device-side LLM prefill and decoding latency, with up to $1.92\times$ decoding speedup at comparable embedding memory usage.

articles.title_zh: 传送一次, 询问本地: 压缩音频- 视频内存, 用于On- Device问答
articles.content_zh: 关于轻量级用户设备的视听问题回答需要平衡速度、内存使用、隐私和通信。 一种方法是在服务器上运行视听编码器,在用户设备上运行轻量级语言解码器,在卸载媒体编码时保留局部问题. 然而,转让和处理完整的多式联运代表仍然费用高昂。 我们建议建立一个无培训、无查询、不可知的代号搜索框架,在传输前构建一个可重复使用的紧凑内存。 我们把视频时空块和对齐的音频窗口定义为玩家,并通过Monte Carlo Shapley估值估计其重要性. 我们采用嵌入式覆盖目标,将查询-独立效用与跨模式冗余校准相结合,并通过边际覆盖收益奖励单一模式的多样性。 我们保留了高分球员在有限象征性预算下嵌入的原始地标,并将由此产生的内存一次性转出,再用于以后的局部问题。 使用视频-SALMONN 2+(3B)和视频-SALMONN 2 Pro(4B)进行Video-MME、Daily-Omni和Video-Holmes的实验表明,我们的方法在所有被评价的场合的比较压缩方法中实现了最佳或捆绑最佳的QA精度。 我们的方法比这些方法提高了12.86-14.62个百分点,同时实现了最低设备侧LLM预填和解码层,在相似的嵌入内存使用中,解码速度可达1.92\times$。

articles.title: UnrealEvent: Synthetic Dataset Generation and Annotation for Event-Based Vision
articles.content: Event-based cameras provide high temporal resolution, low power consumption, and a high dynamic range, but progress in event-based object detection remains constrained by the scarcity of annotated training data. To solve this issue, this paper introduces the tool UnrealEvent, a synthetic dataset-generation pipeline implemented in Unreal Engine 5.5. The pipeline combines a V2E-inspired event-frame generator with EasySynth semantic-rendering passes, allowing rendered level sequences to be converted into paired event representations and YOLO-format bounding-box annotations without manual labeling. Events are generated from per-pixel log-luminance differences between consecutive frames, with contrast thresholds sampled independently from a normal distribution to emulate the fabrication-induced threshold mismatch of real sensors. Using this pipeline, we provide a synthetic dataset and evaluate YOLOv8 detectors under synthetic, zero-shot real, and real fine-tuning training on eTraM. The results show strong in-domain synthetic performance but a substantial synthetic-to-real gap, especially for pedestrians. Fine-tuning on a small real subset improves real-domain performance, while the remaining gap highlights the importance of asset diversity and sensor calibration.

articles.title_zh: Unreal Event: 合成数据集生成和基于事件的视图注释
articles.content_zh: 基于事件相机提供高时间分辨率,低功耗,高动态范围,但基于事件物体检测的进展仍受附加说明的训练数据稀缺所制约. 为了解决这个问题,本文引入了UnrealEvent这一工具,即由Unreal Engine 5.5所执行的合成数据集生成管道. 管道结合了一款由V2E启发的事件帧生成器和EasySynth语义-递接通道,可以将已实现的等位序列转换成对等的事件表示和YOLO格式的边框说明而无需手动作标签. 事件是由相接相框之间的每像素日志发光差异所产生,对比阈值从正常分布中独立抽取,以模仿由制造引起的真实传感器的阈值不匹配. 利用这个管道,我们提供了一个合成数据集,并评价了YOLOv8探测器在合成,零发真实,真实的微调eTraM上的培训. 结果显示,域内合成性能很强,但合成与实际差距很大,对行人来说尤其如此。 细化一个小的真子集可以改善实域性能,而所剩空白凸显出资产多样性和传感器校正的重要性.

articles.title: RFW-S: Everyday Deformable Objects with Independent Simulation Verification
articles.content: Large-scale robotic simulation requires diverse deformable objects with executable physical properties and realistic interaction behaviors. However, existing 3D asset collections primarily emphasize visual diversity, while scalable physical construction and verification remain challenging. We introduce RFW-S, a large-scale dataset of 83,365 simulation-verified assets spanning 485 everyday categories across five structural families: soft solids, cloth sheets, shells, garments, and bags. We develop an automated pipeline integrating reference-guided 3D generation, structure-aware physical modeling, and LLM-assisted parameter estimation and calibration. To ensure physical reliability, we introduce an independent simulation verification framework that evaluates object behaviors under interactions distinct from those used for parameter calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of independent verification and characterize deformable responses under different physical configurations. We further evaluate robotic grasping in terms of both task success and object integrity, and demonstrate the physical realism of our simulated objects through sim-to-real replay of fragile-object manipulation. RFW-S provides a scalable foundation for physically grounded simulation and embodied robotic learning.

articles.title_zh: RFW-S:具有独立模拟核查的每日可变形物体
articles.content_zh: 大规模机器人模拟需要具有可执行物理属性和现实互动行为的多样性可变形物体. 然而,现有的三维资产收藏主要强调视觉多样性,而可扩展的实体构造和核查仍然具有挑战性。 我们引入了RFW-S, 一个由83,365个模拟验证资产组成的大规模数据集, 跨越了485个日常类别, 跨越了五个结构家庭:软固体、布单、贝壳、服装和袋子。 我们开发了一个自动管道,将参考制导的3D生成、结构感知的物理模型以及LLM辅助参数估计和校正结合起来。 为确保物理可靠性,我们引入了一个独立的模拟核查框架,用以评价相互作用下与参数校正所使用的相互作用下的对象行为。 广泛的实验表明独立核查的有效性,并描述不同物理结构下可变形的反应。 我们进一步从任务成功和物体完整性的角度评价机器人的把握,并通过对脆弱物体操纵的模拟回放来展示模拟物体的物理现实主义. RFW-S为物理基础模拟提供了可扩展的基础并体现了机器人学习.

articles.title: FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond
articles.content: Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. We analyze this mismatch on Video-MME-v2 and find that different question subsets prefer different frozen frame-budget policies, while uniformly increasing the frame count does not reliably improve all metrics. These findings motivate fixed-mean frame-budget routing, a controlled inference setting in which each question may receive a different frame budget while the average budget matches a uniform reference. We introduce FrameRouter, a training-free test-time framework that combines an evidence-demand router, a budget-constrained allocation rule, and a frozen bank of frame-sampling policies. By controlling how much visual evidence each question receives while leaving the underlying samplers unchanged, FrameRouter is orthogonal to query-aware frame selection. Across Video-MME-v2 and several long-video understanding benchmarks, FrameRouter improves long-video question answering by using the same average visual budget more selectively across questions. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/FrameRouter.

articles.title_zh: 框架路透:关于视频-MME-v2及以后的长视频理解框架预算路线
articles.content_zh: 像Video-MME-v2这样的长视频问题回答基准,通常对每个问题的系统进行统一框架预算的评价,尽管每个查询实际要求的证据有明显的差异. 我们分析Video-MME-v2上的这种不匹配,发现不同的问题子集更喜欢不同的被冻结的帧预算政策,同时统一增加帧数并不能可靠地改进所有度量. 这些结论激励了固定-平均框架预算的路径,这是一种可控制的推论设置,每个问题都可能得到不同的框架预算,而平均预算则符合统一的参考。 我们引入了Frame Router,一个无培训测试时间框架,结合了证据需求路由器,预算限制分配规则,以及被冻结的帧抽样政策库. 通过控制每个问题收到多少可视证据,同时使基本的采样者保持不变,Framewter是正交式的,用于了解查询框选择。 在Video-MME-v2和若干长视频理解基准中,Framewter通过更有选择地使用相同的平均视觉预算,改进了长视频问题的回答。 代码见https://github.com/bingjunluo/FrameRouter。

articles.title: ReTouchGS: Ultralight Render-free Aesthetic Color Enhancement and Transfer for 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Existing 3DGS color transfer and interactive editing methods are guided by reference images and user-specified color adjustments. However, in many applications, users simply want aesthetically guided color enhancement that automatically makes the scene more visually appealing while maintaining consistent colors and tones across viewpoints. We present ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS models. It predicts a scene-level color lookup table (LUT) from the model and its associated camera parameters. ReTouchGS also supports reference-guided color transfer by fitting a scene-level LUT using one edited view of the same scene and its corresponding original render. A shared blend-aware color refinement network with only 44.7K parameters refines an analytic color update to realize either color mapping without rendering. It preserves geometry and delivers standard 3DGS assets in seconds. We also design the ReTouch3D benchmark to support the evaluation of aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer across viewpoints. Experiments demonstrate high color accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenes in both aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.

articles.title_zh: ReTouchGS:用于3D高斯镀层的超光速无美学色彩增强和转移
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板(3DGS)可以进行相片现实化的场景重建. 现有的3DGS颜色传输和交互式编辑方法以参考图像和用户指定颜色调整为指南. 然而,在许多应用中,用户只是希望以美学指导的色彩增强,这种增强会自动使场景在视觉上更具吸引力,同时保持一致的颜色和跨视线的声调. 我们介绍ReTouchGS, 据我们所知,这是对预先训练的3DGS模型进行无参考美学色彩增强的第一个框架。 它从模型及其相机相关参数中预测出一个场景级的色彩取景表(LUT). 调试 GS还支持使用同一场景的一经编辑的视图及其相应的原始渲染,通过安装场景级LUT来进行参考制导色相传输. 一个只有44.7K参数的共享的混合-感知色素精炼网络,精炼了分析色素更新,以实现不渲染的色素映射两种. 它保存了几何并提供了标准3DGS资产以秒. 我们还设计了ReTouch3D基准,以支持对美学色彩增强的评价和跨视角的参考指向色彩转移. 实验在美学色彩增强和参考指向色彩转移中都表现出了高的色彩精度和强通向看不见的场景.

articles.title: Refin3R: Geometry-Guided Refinement for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
articles.content: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.

articles.title_zh: Refine3R:几何-指向改进后用于Feed-Forward 三维重建
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 三维重建模型预测出从多幅图像中以单行道得到的密集点地图. 然而,如果没有明确的几何限制,它们的预测往往在各种观点上不一致,缺乏精细的精确度. 近代方法包含了相机姿势或深度等几何前缀,但仅作为辅助输入使用,独立处理每个视图,或者只在有前缀的情况下再细化几何. 我们提出Refine3R,它用结构-从-运动(SfM)点来改进向导点地图,在图像网格上宣传SfM几何. 在其双分支架构中,一个2D分支利用几何-认知主干特征将SfM几何扩展出覆盖范围以外,而一个3D分支因在所有观点的SfM点之上,捕获了图像网格单独无法代表的多视图结构. 两个分支双向交换信息,共同完善每个视图,产生密集而准确的点图. 在整个ScanNet++、ETH3D、Tanks-Qemples以及领域外的人类和外科场景中,Refine3R在点地图精确度方面一贯优于饲料前进和几何制导方法,同时运行速度快于最强的几何制导基线。

articles.title: Wall-to-wall maps of canopy height and aboveground carbon across the Atlantic Forest
articles.content: Global canopy height maps are increasingly used to estimate forest carbon, yet their regional accuracy is rarely tested. We present wall-to-wall maps of canopy height (10~m) and aboveground carbon density (30~m) for the Brazilian Atlantic Forest in 2024. Height was predicted by a deep learning network fusing Sentinel-2 reflectance, Sentinel-1 and ALOS PALSAR backscatter and ALOS elevation, trained on 7{,}179 and tested on 1{,}793 patches (58{,}800~km$^2$) from a statewide airborne LiDAR campaign over São Paulo state, Brazil. On held-out test patches, the root mean square error is 3.05~m at 10~m and 2.58~m at 30~m, and the model was validated at two LiDAR sites outside São Paulo. Over the same pixels, the Meta and World Resources Institute global product has more than twice this error. A power law fitted to 124 inventory plots converted canopy height to above ground carbon density. The remaining forest holds 1{,}944~Tg~C over 28.3~Mha. Global products therefore need local validation before use in carbon accounting.

articles.title_zh: 横跨大西洋森林的树冠高地和地上碳的从墙到墙的地图
articles.content_zh: 全球林冠高地图被越来越多地用于估计森林碳,但其区域准确性却很少被测试. 我们为2024年的巴西大西洋森林绘制了树冠高度(10~m)和地上碳密度(30~m)的从墙到墙的地图。 高度是由一个深层学习网络预言的: 引信Sentinel-2反射、Sentinel-1和ALOS PALSAR后向散射和ALOS高地,经过7{,}179次训练,并经过1{,}793个补丁(58{,}800~km$^2$)测试,来自巴西圣保罗州上空的全州空中LiDAR运动. 在被搁置的测试补丁上,根平均平方误差为:10~m时为3.05~m;30~m时为2.58~m;该模型在圣保罗外的两个LiDAR站点被验证. 在同一像素上,Meta和世界资源研究所的全球产品有超过两倍的这个错误. 配有124个库存地块的动力定律将树冠高度转换为地上碳密度。 其余的森林占据着 1{,}944~Tg~C大于28.3~Mha. 因此,全球产品在用于碳核算之前需要当地验证。

articles.title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
articles.content: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.

articles.title: When Anchors Shift the Target: Advantage-Gated Adaptation for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Forward-process reinforcement learning adapts diffusion and flow-matching models by re-noising rewarded generations into regression targets. Because negative advantages induce concave updates with unbounded repulsive gradients, existing methods stabilize training using cached predictions from a moving policy copy, yet these anchors also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling: after separating frozen-reference regularizers, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these roles. Positive samples retain standard target fitting, whose self-limiting update vanishes at the observed target independently of the moving anchor. Negative samples instead use the first-order tangent of the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction, preserving the local repulsion direction with a prediction-independent gradient. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these requirements uniquely determine the parameter-free gate $ω(a)=\max(-a,0)$. Because the moving copy provides local linearization rather than retention, AGA assigns long-horizon behavior preservation to a frozen pretrained reference regularized at its operating classifier-free guidance scale, interpreted through an implicit-reward lens. Across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, our experiments show that displacing positive targets degrades visual quality and heightens sensitivity to policy-copy schedules, whereas AGA consistently improves the reward--quality trade-off.

articles.title: Automated Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation for Underwater Litter Detection: A Comparison of Generative Approaches
articles.content: Underwater object detection is often limited by scarce and imbalanced training data and by strong appearance variations caused by turbidity, lighting, and differences between sensors. Existing data augmentation strategies, such as geometric or color augmentation or fully synthetic image generation with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), either lack semantic realism, fail to respect scene physics, or require additional annotations. In low-data domains like underwater environmental monitoring, the need for additional annotations is often the core bottleneck. Collecting new footage is hard, but labeling this dataset is even more time-consuming and costly, which limits how quickly a usable dataset can be constructed. We propose a unified fully automated zero-annotation pipeline that inserts class-conditioned trash objects into real underwater frames while preserving the original background context. Starting from sampled bounding boxes, each box is converted into an insertion mask and the object is pasted or generated within it, while the same box coordinates are automatically written as the corresponding annotation. Because labels are derived directly from the sampled boxes, the pipeline generates fully labeled training data for low-data settings without any manual annotation. Within this single pipeline we compare three strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation. We evaluate bounding-box faithfulness, visual realism, and the impact of the generated samples on downstream detector performance on the SeaClear underwater debris dataset. Results show that DALL-E improves detection performance in four of five domains, with relative gains of up to 96 percent over the real-only baseline.

articles.title_zh: 自动无注释合成器 水下垃圾检测数据生成:基因方法比较
articles.content_zh: 水下物体的探测往往因训练数据稀少和不平衡而受到限制,并由于扰动、照明和传感器之间的差异而造成强烈的外观变化而受到限制。 现有的数据增强策略,如几何或色彩增强,或用Generative Adversarial Networks(GANs)完全合成图像生成,要么缺乏语义现实主义,不尊重场景物理学,要么需要附加说明. 在水下环境监测等低数据领域,需要附加说明往往是核心瓶颈. 收集新的镜头很困难,但给这个数据集贴上标签更加费时和昂贵,这限制了一个可用数据集的构建速度. 我们提出一个统一的全自动的零注解管道,在保留原始背景的同时,将有类条件的垃圾物品插入真正的水下框架. 从被取样的边框起,每个框被转换为插入口罩并被粘贴或在其内部生成,而同个框坐标则被自动写入相应的注释. 由于标签直接取自被采样的盒,管道生成全标签的低数据设置培训数据,而没有任何人工注释. 在这个单一的管道中,我们比较了三种策略:复制-再版、稳定分泌再版和DALL-E成像型。 我们评价了边框的忠诚度,视觉现实性,以及生成的样品对下游探测器在"海清"水下碎片数据集性能的影响. 结果显示,DALL-E在5个领域中的4个领域提高了检测性能,相对比实际基准提高96%。

articles.title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.content: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and training one teacher per domain with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), directly or after an SFT warm-up, and distilling the teachers into one student with MOPD. We evaluate on 21 image STEM, image perception, and video reasoning benchmarks after we decontaminate the training data against them. The comparison establishes MOPD of teachers trained with GSPO directly from Qwen3.5-9B as the best recipe: the student closely matches each teacher on its own domain and is on average above the mixed-training baselines on the same prompts. Since MOPD already merges the domain capabilities that MixRL would otherwise have to learn, its student is a stronger starting point for RL, and we ask whether the same data can carry the model further from there: we add MixRL on top of the MOPD student, on the same prompts and with the same settings, which, to our knowledge, no prior VLM recipe has studied. The same prompts still improve the MOPD student, with no collapse, and give our main model, M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. MOPD and MixRL can therefore work as consecutive stages that get more out of the same data. We release all data, the training code, and the checkpoints of every stage.

articles.title_zh: M3OPD-Reasoner:培训后多种方式与多教师在政策上进行分解的开放食谱
articles.content_zh: 多教师政策分解(MOPD)使一名学生能够通过学习自己产生的答复来吸收几个域教师的技能。 我们介绍多模式模式多教学者政策分解因子(M3OPD-Reasoner),这是训练后视觉语言模式(VLM)在三个推理领域完全开放的配方:图像STEM,图像感知和视频. 我们管理两个数据集,M3OPD-SFT-1.35M用于有监督的微调(SFT)和M3OPD-RL-193K用于强化学习,并有可核查的奖励. 根据这些数据,我们比较了从Quen3.5-9B开始的训练后食谱:对所有领域(MixSFT和MixRL)的混合数据培训一个模型,直接或经过SFT热身后,每个领域培训一名教师,并将教师分解为MOPD的一个学生。 我们用21个图像 STEM,图像感知, 和视频推理基准 来评估, 比较将直接从Quen3.5-9B接受普惠制教学培训的教师的MOPD确定为最佳配方:学生在自己的领域与每位教师密切匹配,平均高于同一提示的混合培训基线。 由于MOPD已经合并了MixRL否则必须学习的域名能力,所以其学生是RL的更强起点,我们询问同样的数据能否从那里更进一步地携带模型:我们把MixRL加到MOPD学生的上方,在相同的提示上和设置上,据我们所知,没有研究过之前的VLM配方. 同样的提示仍然改善了MOPD的学生,没有倒塌,并给出了我们的主要模型M3OPD-Reasoner-9B. 因此,MOPD和MixRL可以作为连续的阶段工作,从同一个数据中获取更多的数据. 我们公布所有数据 训练守则 以及每个阶段的检查站

articles.title: Check Your Blind Spots: Decision-Guided Perception by Probing the Planner with Hypothetical Objects
articles.content: Not every perception error changes the planner's action. Yet adaptive-resolution perception chooses where to spend high-resolution computation from image cues, which can neither reliably point to an object that low resolution missed nor tell which objects matter to the planner. We observe that the planner can say where an object would matter before anything is seen: inserting a hypothetical object at a location tests whether its action would change. Decision-Guided Speculative Perception (DGSP) treats the low-resolution scene and its action as a draft and probes the planner in this way to obtain a decision-sensitivity field, the locations where an unseen object would change the action. Only this field and the support, the detections on which the current action rests, are verified at high resolution, repeatedly until the action is stable. For two planner classes, we prove that DGSP returns exactly the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception if crop detections match whole-frame ones and the crops cover the field, conditions that real images meet approximately. On three driving datasets, it reproduces this action on about 98% of frames with about a quarter of the pixels. At the pixel cost of uniform downscaling, it repairs more of the draft's disagreements with this action, brakes falsely less often, and recovers many more of the decision-relevant objects that the draft misses.

articles.title: When a Larger Guidance Scale Repairs Text-to-Video Failures and When It Does Not
articles.content: When a text-to-video diffusion model ignores part of a prompt, the usual first fix is to raise the classifier-free guidance scale. This paper is a measurement study of when that fix works. On Mochi, the same increase repairs failures on rare compositions ("a snowy beach") beyond what generating again does, does not repair negations ("a highway with no vehicles"), where it fixes fewer failures than generating again does, and changes nothing for events that must happen late in a clip ("a sandcastle that a wave washes flat"). Which of these happens can be known in advance, from the prompt and one inexpensive score. The score, which we call demand, measures how strongly the denoiser reacts to the part of the prompt that the failed video leaves out, and it is read from the first quarter of denoising, before any video exists. Our main finding is a condition: raising the scale is effective only when the prompt contains no negation and no event tied to a specific time, and when demand is sufficiently high, with recovery clearly higher above a fitted threshold than below it. Published corrections for the three failure types, used as fixed probes, behave as this account predicts. A short decision rule follows: before generating again, a user can tell whether the most common fix is worth trying, and what to use when it is not.

articles.title_zh: 当一个更大的指导缩放修复文本到视频失败和当它不修复时
articles.content_zh: 当一个从文本到视频的传播模型忽略了一个快件的一部分时,通常的第一个修补就是提高无分级器的指导尺度. 本文是对何时修复工程的测量研究. 在"莫奇"(Mochi)上,同样增加的稀有成分("一片雪地海滩")的修复故障,超出了再生成的效果,不修复否定("一条没有车辆的高速公路"),修复故障比再生成少,对于必须在剪辑后期发生的事件("一波会冲平"的沙砾"),也没有任何改变. 从迅速和低廉的分数来看,哪些情况可以事先知道。 我们称之为要求的分数,衡量denoiser对被失败的视频遗漏的提示部分的反应有多强烈,在任何视频存在之前,它是从去诺音的第一季度读取的. 我们的主要发现是一个条件:提高规模只有在下列情况下才有效:即时通知没有否定,没有与特定时间挂钩的事件,而且需求足够高,而且恢复程度明显高于规定的阈值。 公布的三种故障类型作为固定探测器的校正行为与本账号预测的一样. 下面是简短的决定规则:在再次生成之前,用户可以分辨出最常用的修补是否值得尝试,以及在不尝试时使用什么.

articles.title: Tracking Ethological Behaviors of Broiler Chickens Through Computer Vision (YoloV11) Using an Android Mobile Device
articles.content: This study developed and evaluated a computer vision model for automated ethological behavior classification of broiler chickens in climate-controlled poultry houses. Using publicly available videos preprocessed and manually annotated into three classes (sitting, standing, and feeding), the YOLOv11 model was trained and deployed on an Android application via TFLite conversion. Exploratory analysis ensured dataset consistency and visual quality, while evaluation showed class-dependent performance: higher robustness for static postures (sitting, AP=0.531; precision=100%) and lower accuracy for dynamic behaviors (feeding, AP=0.292; recall=0.20). Tests with unseen images demonstrated significant improvements, achieving accuracies of 98.04% for sitting, 83.33% for standing, and 67.65% for feeding. The model showed effective generalization in real farm environments, supporting its potential for continuous behavioral monitoring, early welfare assessments, and decision-making in precision poultry farming. These findings establish a technical foundation for future mobile-based applications at commercial scale, reinforcing the role of computer vision in automated animal welfare evaluation.
