articles.title_zh: 利用Android移动设备,通过计算机视野追踪Broiler鸡的种族行为(YoloV11)
articles.content_zh: 这项研究开发并评价了一个计算机视觉模型,用于在气候可控的家禽屋中对布鲁尔鸡进行自动化的道德行为分类. YOLOv11模型使用公开的视频预处理和手动注释分为三个类(坐、站和喂),通过TFLite转换在Android应用上培训和部署. 探索分析确保了数据集的一致性和视觉质量,而评价显示的是类依赖性性能:静态姿势的强性更高(坐姿,AP=0.531;精度=100%),而动态行为的精度更低(喂食,AP=0.292;召回=0.20)。 以隐形图像进行的试验显示,情况有显著改善,坐椅的气率为98.04%,站立的气率为83.33%,喂养的气率为67.65%。 该模型在真实的农场环境中显示出有效的通俗化,支持其持续行为监测、早期福利评估以及精准家禽养殖决策的潜力。 这些研究结果为今后商业规模的移动应用奠定了技术基础,加强了计算机视觉在动物福利自动评价中的作用.

articles.title: The Rhythm of Generated Video: Latent Chunking Leaves Periodic Traces in Compressed Bitstreams
articles.content: Most AI-generated video detectors analyze decoded pixels and overlook how videos are produced. We show that causal video autoencoders leave an architecture-specific rhythm in compressed bitstreams: their temporal stride concentrates unpredictable content at latent-chunk boundaries, so rate-distortion optimized encoders allocate bits periodically. Without decoding pixels, we observe four-frame pulses in CogVideoX and Wan2.2 and eight-frame pulses in LTX-Video, which are absent from content-matched camera footage. Passing camera footage through a generator's autoencoder alone induces the pulse, supporting its proposed origin. A training-free peak-ratio statistic separates generated from camera video (AUC 0.84-0.94) and persists across tested quantization settings and H.264/H.265 encoding. Frame-size traces also identify four commercial generators, with 89.2%, 84.1%, and 83.0% accuracy under H.264, H.265, and AV1, beating the pixel-based UnivFD baseline (72.7-73.6%). Our results directly link generative architecture to measurable coding demand.

articles.title_zh: 生成视频的韵律:Latent Chunking 在压缩比特流中的定期出轨
articles.content_zh: 大多数AI出产的视频探测器分析解码像素并忽略视频的制作方式. 我们显示,因果视频自动编码器在压缩比特流中留下一个特定架构的节奏:它们的时间步程会将不可预测的内容集中在潜在的-chunk边界上,因此速率扭曲优化编码器会定期分配比特. 在没有解码像素的情况下,我们观测到CogVideoX和Wan2.2中的四帧脉冲和LTX-Video中的八帧脉冲,在内容相匹配的相机镜头中没有这些脉冲. 通过一个发电机的自动编码器单独传递相机镜头会诱导脉冲,支持其拟议出处. 从相机录像(AUC 0.84-0.94)中生成的无培训峰值-比例统计数据,在经过测试的量化设置和H.264/H.265编码中持续存在。 框架大小的痕迹还确定了4个商用发电机,H.264、H.265和AV1的精确度分别为89.2%、84.1%和83.0%,打破了以像素为基础的UnivFD基线(72.7%-73.6%)。 我们的成果将基因结构与可衡量的编码需求直接联系起来。

articles.title: CAST: Calibrating Correspondences for Training-Free Biomedical In-Context Segmentation
articles.content: Biomedical image segmentation must keep up with new anatomical structures, subjects, imaging modalities, and acquisition protocols, yet dense expert annotations are scarce and models trained on one cohort often struggle to transfer. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers a way out: a new structure is specified by a few annotated exemplars at inference time. However, reliable correspondence remains challenging in biomedical images, where adjacent structures often share similar appearances, and variations across subjects and imaging conditions further obscure their distinctions. We introduce CAST, a training-free framework built on a frozen DINOv3 backbone to calibrate fine-grained correspondences. Its stability test improves feature reliability at both global and patch-specific levels, while its coherence test assesses whether candidate correspondences are supported by consistent local structural context. Together, these tests enable more reliable correspondence across diverse anatomical structures and imaging conditions. Across eight biomedical benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D segmentation, cross-subject, and cross-modality transfer, CAST outperforms the strongest overall baseline by 12.34 percentage points in Dice and ranks first across all six volumetric settings. The versatility of CAST further opens up opportunities for challenging biomedical applications, including 2D-to-3D segmentation and atlas label transfer.

articles.title_zh: CAST: 校准无培训生物医学论文
articles.content_zh: 生物医学图像的分解必须跟上新的解剖结构、主题、成像模式和获取协议,然而密集的专家说明却很少,对一组人的模型进行培训往往难以转移。 内文分解(ICS)提供了一个出路:在推论时间用几个附加说明的示例来指定了一个新的结构. 然而,可靠的通信在生物医学图像方面仍然具有挑战性,相邻的结构往往具有相似的外观,不同主体和成像条件之间的差异进一步模糊了它们的区别. 我们引入了CAST,一个无培训框架,建立在被冻结的DINOv3主干上,用来校正精细的纹理通信. 其稳定性测试提高了全球和补丁特定层面的可靠性,而一致性测试则评估候选函证是否得到一致的本地结构背景的支持. 这些测试加在一起,可以使不同解剖结构和成像条件之间的对应更加可靠. 在涵盖2D和3D分化、交叉主体和跨模式转移的8个生物医学基准中,CAST在Dice的总基准上的表现超过了最强的12.34个百分点,在所有6个体积环境上排名第一。 化学文摘社的多面性进一步为生物医学应用提供了挑战机会,包括2D至3D分解和地图集标签传输。

articles.title: SpikWM: Efficient End-to-End Spiking World Modeling for Visual Planning
articles.content: Goal-conditioned planning with image observations and goals requires predictions that distinguish visual states and action consequences. Spiking neural networks offer sparse computation, but single-step spikes can obscure motion cues and merge actions with different physical outcomes. We propose the Spiking Latent World Model (SpikWM), an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) with one simulation step per image and one neural update per latent position. Spiking Regional Encoding retains spatial cues through regional pooling. Bi-Spike Action Encoding combines positive and negative binary responses, while Causal Membrane Prediction carries subthreshold evidence across the latent history with learned group-wise time constants. The encoder and predictor are trained jointly on reward-free image--action trajectories using next-embedding prediction and SIGReg. With a common planner, SpikWM achieves mean success rates of $88.67\%$, $97.33\%$, $99.33\%$, and $86.67\%$ on Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube, respectively, outperforming two spiking baselines. Push-T ablations support each module, and controlled replays examine responses to appearance and physical state changes. Under a matched planning budget, SpikWM reduces estimated arithmetic energy by $75.6\%$ relative to LeWM. Code will be released at https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM.

articles.title_zh: SpikWM: 视觉规划的高效端到端相接世界建模
articles.content_zh: 以图像观测和目标为条件进行规划需要预测,以区分视觉状态和行动后果。 斯皮克神经网络提供稀有的计算,但单步突起可以模糊运动提示并用不同的物理结果来将动作合并. 我们提出Spiking Latent World Model(SpikWM),一个端到端的联合嵌入式预测架构(JEPA),每个图像有一个模拟步骤,每个潜在位置有一个神经更新. Spiking区域编码通过区域集合保留了空间提示. Bi-Spike Action Encoding结合了正负二进制响应,而Causal Membrane Pregency则携带了潜伏历史的下限证据,并带有有学识的分组时间常数. 编码器和预测器使用下嵌的预测和SIGREG,共同接受无奖励图像动作轨迹的培训. SpikWM拥有一个共同的规划师,其成功率分别为88.67美元、97.33美元、99.33美元和86.67美元,分别超过了两个振幅基线。 Push-T活化支持每个模块,受控重放检查对外观和物理状态变化的反应. 根据相应的规划预算,SpikWM将估计的算术能比LeWM减少75.6美元. 将在https://github.com/ShawnYE618/SpikWM发布代码.

articles.title: Rescaling OLS-Merged Adapters To Improve Personalized Image Generation
articles.content: Merging multiple adapters into a single image generation model reduces deployment costs while preserving diverse task capabilities or personalization modes. State-of-the-art methods such as RegMean, Mix-of-Show, and Subspace Routing fit the outputs of the merged model to those of the individual adapters using ordinary least squares (OLS). We show that this reconstruction objective systematically shrinks task-specific signals whenever the activation distributions of different tasks overlap, producing a merged adapter that is too weak for downstream use. We derive a decomposition that quantifies this shrinkage and propose rescaling the merged update to restore signal strength. On multi-subject personalization with up to 30 merged adapters, rescaling substantially improves subject fidelity over unscaled baselines. Our approach also improves results on style transfer, concept erasure, image classification, and LLM-based text classification.

articles.title_zh: 调整 OLS- Merged 适配器,以改善个性化图像生成
articles.content_zh: 将多个适配器合并成一个单一的图像生成模型,既能降低部署成本,又能保留多种任务能力或个性化模式. 先进的方法,如RegMean,Mix-of-Show,和Subspace Routing,将合并模型的输出与使用普通最小平方(OLS)的单个适配器的输出相匹配. 我们显示,每当不同任务的激活分布重叠时,这一重建目标系统收缩了任务特定信号,产生了一个无法下游使用的合并适配器. 我们得到一个分解 以量化这种收缩 并提出调整合并更新 以恢复信号强度 在多主体个性化方面,最多可有30个合并的适配器,比起未分级的基线,调整对主体的忠诚程度大有改进。 我们的方法还改进了样式转移、概念去除、图像分类和基于LLM的文本分类的结果。

articles.title: MI-Hyper: Generating Multiple Instance Models for Weight Space Transfer Learning in Histopathology via Mixed Tasks Pretrained HyperNetwork
articles.content: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction aims to generalize to new pathology tasks without parameter updates at deployment. MI-Zero makes these predictions by pooling patch-text similarities. Conditional weight generation, combined with supervision from diverse pathology tasks, offers an alternative: learning to construct predictive rules from task descriptions. We introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to generate the aggregation and classification weights of multiple instance learning (MIL) models. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis jointly using source labels. We then freeze the basis and refine the generator. The generated task weights are reused across cases. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 over MI-Zero by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. These results support task-conditioned weight generation as a promising approach to weight-space transfer for long-sequence modeling.

articles.title_zh: MI-Hyper: 通过混合任务生成多重实例模型, 用于在历史病理学中进行体重空间转移学习
articles.content_zh: 零镜头全滑成像(WSI)的预测旨在被概括到新的病理学任务,在部署时没有参数更新. MI-Zero通过集合补丁文本的相似性来作出这些预测. 有条件的权重生成,加上来自不同病理任务的监督,提供了一个替代方案:学习从任务描述中构建预测规则. 我们引入了MI-Hyper,这是一个跨混合任务预先训练的超网络,生成多个实例学习模型的聚合和分类权重. 我们首先用源标签 来训练发电机和共享的MIL基础 然后,我们冻结基础 并完善发电机。 生成的任务权重在个案中重复使用。 在52个病理数据集的308个任务中,MI-Hyper改进了平均AUC,平衡精度和宏F1比MI-Zero分别提高了1.85分,1.17分和0.57分. 在一些分子预测任务上,AUC和平衡精度都提高了20多分. 这些结果支持以任务为条件的重量生成,作为长序列模型化的重量空间转移的一种有希望的方法.

articles.title: CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
articles.content: Coding agents make videos by writing and refining programs in a build--inspect--edit loop. A finished film costs a median of $2.85 in model calls and 11 minutes, over a third of that time in builds that block the agent. We find that much of this time is avoidable, for two reasons. First, 37.5% of the frames of a session's later films were drawn before, many shifted in time or inside an edited scene. Second, half of the builds stop at a check, where the agent needs only the verdict, but which builds stop is unknown until the checks finish. We present CodeReel, a training-free execution layer behind agents' existing commands. Exact frame reuse keys each frame by its drawing commands, regardless of its position in time, and reuses each frame whose key recurs. Blocking-aware scheduling runs the checks first and starts the render alongside them, at idle priority, unless the session's recent builds make a pass unlikely. Scheduling spends CPU to answer sooner and reuse returns it; exact keys let later versions use frames rendered for a failed one as the agent thinks. We introduce EditLoop, a benchmark of replayable agent sessions whose films are checked against renders from scratch. On it, CodeReel cuts the agent's wait by 36.3% against Rebuild, a warm pipeline with parallel rendering, and by 57.9% against Sequential, today's step-by-step pipeline. On time-shifting edits its reuse renders 43.9%, close to the 43.0% whose pixels are new, while Manim-style caching renders 99.8%. With real agents, the median wait per build is 0.62x Rebuild's in Claude Code, on topics never used in development, and 0.67x in Codex CLI. The gain holds for five models and two frameworks.

articles.title: Training-Free Building Change Detection with Example-Induced Discriminants
articles.content: Building change detection (BCD) relies on dense annotations that are costly to collect across regions. A few annotated examples offer a more economical way to specify the target, but change maps provide incomplete building supervision: they label only changed buildings and leave the building-containing date unspecified. Our key observation is that these annotations nevertheless reveal features that recognize buildings in other images, including unchanged ones. We present Linear INduced Discriminants (LIND), a training-free framework that turns regional feature contrasts into a reusable linear building classifier. Using a single frozen vision transformer, it unifies building recognition and temporal comparison in the same feature space. This approach requires neither text prompts nor an auxiliary segmentation model. Only one parameter is tuned on a single validation dataset and then kept fixed across datasets and shot settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong detection accuracy, cross-dataset transfer, and efficient inference, with extensions to other semantic classes and broader land-cover changes. Change annotations thus provide a compact visual specification for detection in new scenes. Code: https://github.com/lzcn/lind

articles.title: Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer for End-to-End Image Generation
articles.content: Pixel-space diffusion learns visual representations and image generation jointly in a single end-to-end training stage, without a separately pretrained visual encoder. However, plain pixel-space Transformers still trail leading two-stage latent diffusion models in generation quality and training efficiency. We hypothesize that part of this gap arises from retaining one token per patch throughout the backbone, which does not explicitly encourage a visual hierarchy that summarizes related content at progressively coarser levels. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers (HiT), which progressively group related tokens and represent each group with a single token. The main Transformer bottleneck processes these compact group tokens, and ungrouping restores features to their original image positions. A compression budget regulates the average compression ratio across the batch, allowing group memberships and counts to vary across images and diffusion timesteps during both training and generation. The model exhibits emergent semantic structure, learning to group coherent objects and object parts without segmentation labels. In text-to-image generation, HiT further learns to group caption words with image patches depicting the same concepts, without region annotations. HiT achieves 1.48 FID on ImageNet $256\times256$ and reaches comparable generation quality to JiT using approximately 40\% of its cumulative training FLOPs. For text-to-image generation, HiT exceeds UniLiP's average score across five benchmarks with roughly $6\times$ fewer denoiser parameters and $3\times$ fewer forward FLOPs. These results suggest that learning a visual hierarchy within the generator breaks down the barrier to stronger image generation without external visual pretraining.

articles.title: Is model self-assessment enough for diverse LVLM ensembles?
articles.content: Ensembles of diverse Large Vision Language Models have demonstrated performance beyond that of single models across multiple datasets and tasks. However, the necessary aggregation process usually relies on training, parameter fitting, or complex task-specific pipelines. Furthermore, evaluation is limited, making a fair comparison difficult. We create a unified pipeline where we perform candidate response selection: we build an ensemble by selecting the best answer from a set provided by different models. We comprehensively evaluate across 34 different means of confidence estimation, 24 ensemble configurations, 20 datasets, and two prompt specifications. We show that simple training and parameter-free approaches can be sufficient, even for ensembles of different architectures. These simple self-assessment approaches rely solely on each constituent model's confidence, without explicit calibration, yet are able to perform better than said constituent models. They are also competitive with more involved alternatives on standard metrics such as accuracy, including on open-ended problems. However, we also discover that dataset, ensemble composition, and prompt wording are key confounding variables insufficiently explored by prior work that significantly affect ensemble performance, such that the ensemble can perform worse than its best constituent model. These must be optimized for to get the most out of ensembles, at the cost of limiting their generalizability. We recommend that practitioners consider training-free ensembles only if deployment conditions can be precisely characterized, with Best-of-N configurations of strong models being a good starting point.

articles.title_zh: 模式自我评估对于多种LVLM组合是否足够?
articles.content_zh: 多种大视野语言模型的集合,在多个数据集和任务中展现了超越单一模型的性能. 然而,必要的汇总过程通常依赖于培训、参数配置或针对具体任务的复杂管道。 此外,评价有限,难以进行公平比较。 我们建立一个统一的管道,我们进行候选人反应选择:我们通过从不同模型提供的一组中选择最佳答案来建立一个组合。 我们全面评价了34个不同的信任估计手段、24个组合组合、20个数据集和两个快速规格。 我们显示,简单的培训和无参数方法就足够了,即使是不同的建筑组合。 这些简单的自我评估方法完全依靠每个组成模型的信心,没有明确的校准,但能够比所述组成模型更好地发挥作用。 它们还在准确性等标准衡量标准,包括开放式问题方面与更多参与的替代品具有竞争力。 然而,我们也发现,数据集、组合组成和即时措辞是以前的工作所未充分探讨的关键混淆变量,这些变量对组合性能有重大影响,因此组合性能可能比其最佳组成模式差。 这些必须加以优化,以便从综艺节目中获得最多的节目,其代价是限制其普及性。 我们建议,只有在部署条件能够精确确定的情况下,执业者才考虑免费培训组合,以N型最佳配置强型为良好起点。

articles.title: Fiberpose: state-of-the-art fiber morphometry and instance segmentation with a distance-transform neural network
articles.content: Analysis of fibrous structures in SEM images is a routine task in biomedical engineering and materials science. However, most available methods for fiber quantification still rely on classical image binarization followed by simple post-processing. These approaches often produce unreliable results in images with weak boundaries, heterogeneous contrast, and densely packed fibers. Here, we introduce Fiberpose, a framework that reformulates fiber analysis as direct regression of a smooth distance-transform (DT) field, together with a novel set of geometry-based algorithms specifically adapted to this representation. The predicted field directly encodes fiber geometry, while the accompanying algorithms enable instance reconstruction and measurement of diameter and orientation within a unified workflow. The framework is implemented as a standalone Python desktop application and a web tool https://fiberpose.org. On an independent dataset of fibrous SEM images, Fiberpose achieved state-of-the-art instance-segmentation accuracy in comparison with SAM2 and Cellpose-SAM, and more accurate diameter measurements than DiameterJ, Fibar and GIFT. The method remains effective in dense and weakly contrasted regions and shows qualitative generalization across microscopy modalities not represented in the training data. Fiberpose therefore provides an interpretable geometric representation and an automated pipeline for reproducible quantitative characterization of fibrous materials.

articles.content_zh: SEM图像中的纤维结构分析是生物医学工程和材料科学中的一项常规任务. 然而,大多数可用的纤维量化方法仍然依赖于古典图像二进制,然后是简单的后处理. 这些方法往往产生不可靠的结果,造成边界薄弱、对比不一和纤维密集的图像。 在这里,我们引入了Fiberpose,这个框架将纤维分析重新定型为平滑相距-变形(DT)场的直接回归,以及一套专门针对这种表示的以几何为主的算法. 所预测的字段直接将纤维几何编码,而相伴随的算法则可以在一个统一的工作流程内对直径和方向进行实例重建和测量. 该框架作为一个独立的Python桌面应用程序和一个网络工具https://fiberpose.org来实施. 在纤维SEM图像的独立数据集上,比起SAM2和Cellpose-SAM,Fiberpose实现了最先进的实例分解精度,并比DiameterJ,Fibar和GIFT更精确地进行了直径测量. 该方法在密集和弱对比的区域依然有效,在培训数据中没有体现的显微镜复制方式中显示出定性的概括。 因此,纤维提供了可解释的几何表示和可复制纤维材料定量定性的自动化管道。

articles.title: A high-dimensional spatial-physical coupling operator for generalizable super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulent flows
articles.content: Accurate representation of turbulent flows requires simultaneously capturing multi-scale spatial structures and the complex, nonlinear coupling between distinct physical quantities (\textit{e.g.}, velocity components and density). In practice, however, turbulent data are often constrained by low spatial resolution due to hardware limitations and computational costs. While current data-driven super-resolution methods have shown promise by learning mappings via convolutional neural networks (CNNs), they typically treat physical variables as independent channels. This simplified approach neglects intrinsic cross-variable correlations, causing models to struggle with high-fidelity reconstruction, particularly under extremely sparse conditions or in out-of-distribution regimes. To bridge this gap, we propose an architecture-agnostic spatial-physical coupling operator that extends the standard convolution into a joint spatial-variable dimension. Unlike conventional linear channel mixing, our framework constructs a unified spatial-physical representation within CNNs to explicitly capture local inter-variable interactions. By lifting features into a higher-dimensional manifold, this operator significantly enhances the model's representation capacity. Experiments demonstrate that this approach enables strong reconstruction performance and zero-shot generalization, offering a physics-aware inductive bias for super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulence. More broadly, this work suggests that high-dimensional operators offer a promising avenue for modeling intricate multi-scale turbulent flows.

articles.title_zh: 一个高维空间物理相接操作器,用于三维相通的多分辨相通的相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通
articles.content_zh: 准确反映动荡流动需要同时捕捉多尺度空间结构以及不同物理量(\textit{例如}、速度组件和密度)之间的复杂、非线性耦合。 但实际上,由于硬件的限制和计算成本,动荡的数据往往受到低空间分辨率的限制。 虽然目前的由数据驱动的超解析方法通过进化神经网络(CNNs)来学习映射显示有希望,但它们通常将物理变量视为独立的通道. 这种简化的方法忽略了内在的可变相关性,导致模型与高忠诚度重建相去甚远,特别是在极其稀少的条件下或分配外的制度下. 为了弥合这一差距,我们提议建立一个结构-不可知的空间-物理耦合操作员,将标准演化扩展到一个空间可变的联合维度。 与传统的线性通道混合不同,我们的框架在CNN内部构建了统一的空间-物理代表,以明确捕捉出局部可变相互作用. 这个操作员通过将特性提升到一个更高维多维度,大大提高了模型的能见度. 实验证明,这种方法能够使重建性能强和零发普通化,为超解三维扰动提供物理学意识的还原偏差. 更广泛地说,这项工作表明,高维操作员为模拟复杂的多尺度动荡流动提供了有希望的途径。

articles.title: Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
articles.content: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry depending on the interaction, and streaming inference must operate in a few causal steps without accumulating drift across self-generated history. We present Invoker-Render, pairing a bidirectional creation model with a causal four-step streaming model under a shared conditioning interface over structural proxies, an appearance reference, and language. Trained on an aligned approximately 200-hour multi-granularity corpus, Invoker-Render honors fine geometric constraints when supplied while synthesizing plausible local motion under coarse proxies, enabling runtime selection of input detail. To bridge bidirectional creation and real-time streaming without compounding step compression and rollout drift, we introduce Progressive Forcing (ProForcing). ProForcing first trains a causal predictor and distills it into a four-step renderer using histories derived from training videos. Training then shifts to continuous self-generated rollouts. A pipelined serving stack supports efficient streaming inference. Experiments show versatile control across proxy families, granularities, and camera paths, consistent gains over recent streaming baselines, and stable 30-minute racing rollouts that preserve scene and subject appearance.

articles.title_zh: 代码世界模型 2.0:走向无限可控视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视觉代理将清晰的世界状态模拟从光现实主义视频合成中解析出,为离线剪辑的创建和实时互动流提供可控界面. 然而,一个实际的表述者必须应对两个挑战。 上游代词因相互作用的不同而异,从粗糙的布局到细细的分明几何,而流入推论必须运行在几个因果步骤上,而不会累积跨越自生历史的漂移. 我们提出Invoker-Render, 将双向创建模型与一个因果四步相接的相接模式在结构代词的共享条件界面下对齐, 一个外观参考,以及语言. Invoker-Render对大约200小时的多角体进行校正训练,在提供时遵守精细的几何限制,同时在粗细的代用物下合成合理的局部运动,从而能够对输入细节进行运行时间选择。 为了搭接双向创建和实时流线,而无需复合步压和出行漂移,我们引入了进取推进(Processing). 利用从培训录像中得出的历史,先对因果预测器进行检测,再将其分解成四步渲染器。 然后,培训转向持续自发推出。 管道式服务堆栈支持高效的流线推论. 实验显示对代理家庭、颗粒物和相机路径的多功能控制,与最近的流线基线相比不断提高,以及稳定地30分钟的赛跑,以保持场景和标的外观。

articles.title: SWIR-cGAN: Synthesizing SWIR Bands Using VNIR Imagery from CBERS and AMAZONIA-1
articles.content: Spectral band synthesis is an important research topic in remote sensing. The Brazilian satellites CBERS-4, CBERS-4A, and AMAZONIA-1 provide high temporal resolution (1-3 days) visible and near-infrared (VNIR) imagery through the Wide-Field Imager (WFI), but lack short-wave infrared (SWIR) bands. Recent deep learning methods have shown promising results for spectral synthesis, but challenges remain for cross-satellite generalization and spectrally distant bands. This paper presents a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) with an attention-enhanced U-net generator and a multi-loss objective to synthesize Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR bands 11 (SWIR-1) and 12 (SWIR-2) from WFI VNIR inputs. Experiments used 4,125 patches for training and cross-validation and 1,026 unseen patches for testing, with hyperparameters optimized using a subset of the training data. On SWIR-1, the model achieved SSIM of 0.900, PSNR of 31.44 dB, and MAE of 0.019 in TOA reflectance. On SWIR-2, it achieved SSIM of 0.917, PSNR of 33.35 dB, and MAE of 0.015. Benchmarking was performed on the test dataset, with each model optimized separately prior to evaluation. SWIR-cGAN outperformed the baselines, particularly for SWIR-2. The ablation study identified the multi-loss as the main performance contributor, while the attention and residual modules provided additional improvements. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of synthesizing SWIR bands from WFI imagery. The SWIR-cGAN is available at https://github.com/marujore/swir-cgan.

articles.title_zh: SWIR-cGAN:合成SWIR 使用 VNIR 的乐队 CBERS和AMAZONIA-1的图像
articles.content_zh: 光谱波段合成是遥感领域的一个重要研究课题. 巴西的CBERS-4号卫星、CBERS-4A号和AMAZONIA-1号卫星通过广域成像仪(WFI)提供高时间分辨率(1至3天)可见和近红外图像,但缺乏短波红外波波段。 最近的深层学习方法显示出光谱合成的可喜结果,但跨卫星通化和光谱相距波段仍存在挑战。 本文提出有条件的基因辅助网络(cGAN),并附有注意增强的U-net生成器和从WFI VNIR投入合成Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR波段11(SWIR-1)和12(SWIR-2)的多损失目标. 实验使用4,125个补丁用于培训和交叉验证,并使用1,026个隐形补丁用于测试,其中高参数的优化使用了培训数据的子集. 在SWIR-1上,该型号在TOA反射中实现了0.900的SSIM,31.44分贝的PSNR和0.019的MAE. 在SWIR-2上,它实现了0.917的SSIM,33.35分贝的PSNR和0.015的MAE. 在测试数据集上进行了基准制定,每个模型在评价前分别优化. SWIR-cGAN的表现超过了基线,特别是SWIR-2。 消减研究确定多亏是主要的业绩贡献者,而注意力和剩余模块则提供了进一步的改进。 我们的研究结果表明,从WFI图像合成SWIR波段是可行的。 SWIR-cGAN可在https://github.com/marujore/swir-cgan上查阅。

articles.title: BRepA: Graph-Based B-Rep Pretraining for Unified CAD Understanding and Generation
articles.content: Boundary representation (B-Rep) of CAD models encodes geometric primitives and their relations as a graph structure, enabling efficient shape modeling within CAD software. Learning on B-Reps for downstream tasks, such as segmentation and novel shape generation, requires specialized neural network designs. Moreover, performance improvements and accelerated training can be achieved with effective pretraining strategies, which is particularly important for tasks with limited labeled B-Rep data. In this paper, we introduce BRepA, a unified self-supervised pretraining framework that explicitly reconstructs both the geometry and topology of B-Rep objects via graph-based modeling. By learning from large-scale unlabeled CAD data only once, BRepA produces representations that generalize across tasks and significantly enhance both discriminative and generative learning. On segmentation tasks, BRepA demonstrates remarkable data efficiency. For instance, with only 1% labeled samples, BRepA pretraining improves mIoU by 32.52% compared to models trained from scratch. On generative tasks, aligning diffusion model representations with pretrained BRepA features substantially accelerates convergence, achieving nearly 2 times faster training while improving generation quality under the same computational budget, despite the diffusion model being roughly 20 times larger than BRepA. Overall, our results show that geometry- and topology-aware B-Rep pretraining provides a powerful foundation for both understanding and generating CAD structures, serving as a versatile representation backbone for diverse downstream applications. We will release the code to facilitate future research.

articles.title_zh: BREPA:为统一CAD理解和生成进行基于图表的B-Rep预训

articles.title: You Only Encode Once: Sub-Pixel-Shifted Frames for Arbitrary-Scale Remote Sensing Super-Resolution with 2D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) of remote sensing images remains challenging due to the limited high-frequency information in a single low-resolution (LR) observation. While multi-frame SR can exploit complementary sub-pixel information, existing approaches often require real multi-frame training sequences and repeated feature encoding, increasing data acquisition demands and computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose SPS-GS (Sub-Pixel-Shifted Gaussian Splatting), an encode-once framework that learns from multi-phase LR observations synthesized from individual high-resolution images, without requiring real multi-frame training sequences. Specifically, Phase-Coherent Aliasing Demodulation (PCAD) exploits shift-dependent aliasing through Fourier-based alignment, phase-aware residual fusion, and least-squares aliasing estimation, enabling multi-frame information to be integrated before a single deep encoding pass. Gaussian Projection Alignment (GPA) then iteratively refines Gaussian centers and colors using multi-observation back-projection to promote observation consistency. The refined Gaussians support continuous rendering at arbitrary scales. Extensive experiments on five remote sensing datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction performance against single-image and multi-frame SR baselines, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency at common scales. The code will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: You Only Encode Once: 任意比例遥感超解析的分像素屏蔽框架 2D高斯平板
articles.content_zh: 由于单一低分辨率观测中高频信息有限,遥感图像任意的超分辨率(ASSR)仍然具有挑战性。 虽然多帧SR可以利用互补的子像素信息,但现有方法往往需要真正的多帧培训序列和重复的特征编码,增加数据获取需要和计算成本. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出SPS-GS(Sub-Pixel-Shifted Gaussian Splating),这是一个从从单个高分辨率图像合成的多相LR观测中吸取教训的编码-once框架,不需要真正的多帧训练序列. 具体来说,相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 高斯投影对接(GPA)再用多观测后向投影来迭代地完善高斯中心与颜色来提升观测一致性. 被精制的高斯人支持在任意的尺度上持续渲染. 5个遥感数据集的广泛实验显示,对照单一图像和多框架的SR基线,重建性能很强,同时保持了通用尺度的竞争性推论效率. 代码将公开发布.

articles.title: Impact of Pretraining Length, Model Size, and Annotation Budget on Downstream Clinical Tasks of Foundation Models in Radiotherapy
articles.content: Cone-beam CT (CBCT) scans acquired during radiotherapy capture changes such as tumor shrinkage and radiation-induced tissue changes, offering great potential for foundation models that help monitor individual treatment responses. However, to our knowledge, no large-scale pretrained models for radiotherapy CBCT exist, and evaluating modeling choices is difficult since downstream tasks are not known in advance. We examine how pretraining length, model size, and finetuning strategy relate to downstream clinical performance, and how metrics tracked during pretraining correlate with it. We pretrain vision transformer encoders with masked image modeling on about 150,000 raw 3D radiotherapy CBCT scans, tracking representation quality via validation loss, effective rank, and linear probing. Downstream tasks are classification of feeding tube presence ($n=51,135$ CBCTs, $1,562$ patients) and clinical characteristics (T-, N-stage, sex, age, tumor site; $n=1,278$ patients) in head and neck cancer. We compare low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and full finetuning against no pretraining, varying annotated dataset size. Pretext validation loss was the most consistent predictor of downstream performance; effective rank and linear probing were also associated, but not consistently across model sizes and finetuning methods. LoRA performed comparably to full finetuning while training only 0.5-2.5% of the parameters. Fully finetuned models consistently outperformed models without pretraining across all sizes, with AUROC 0.91-0.97 vs. 0.58-0.85 for feeding tube classification and 0.99-1.00 vs. 0.71-0.97 for sex classification. Model size had only a small, inconsistent effect, suggesting smaller models suffice at lower computational cost. Code and pretrained models (non-commercial license): https://github.com/alexCortinaU/RT-CBCT_SSL

articles.title_zh: 预训长度、模型规模和注释预算对放射治疗基础模型下游临床任务的影响
articles.content_zh: Cone-beam CT(CBCT)扫描在放射治疗中获取到的肿瘤收缩和辐射引起的组织变化等变化,为有助于监测个人治疗反应的基础模型提供了巨大的潜力. 然而,据我们所知,不存在大规模预训的CBCT放射疗法模型,而且由于事先不知道下游的任务,因此很难评估模型的选择。 我们研究预训时间长度、模型尺寸和微调策略与下游临床表现的关系,以及预训期间的衡量标准如何与之相关。 我们先对视觉变形器进行预演,在大约15万个原始的3D放射疗法CBCT扫描上安装有蒙面图像模型的编码器,通过验证损失,有效分级,线性检测来跟踪表现质量. 下游任务是对喂养管的存在(n=51 135美元CBCTs,1 562美元患者)和临床特征(T-,N-阶段,性别,年龄,肿瘤地点;n=1 278美元患者)进行分类. 我们比较低等级的适应(LORA)和完全微调,而不是预先训练,不同的附加说明的数据集大小. 前文本验证损失是下游性能最一致的预测;有效的分级和线性测试也相关联,但不同模型大小和微调方法之间不一致. LoRA进行了相适应的完全微调,而培训的参数只有0.5%-2.5%。 完全微调的模型在不经过各种尺寸的预先训练的情况下,始终超越模型,供餐管分类的AUROC 0.91-0.97对0.58-0.85,性分类的0.99-1.00对0.71-0.97。 模型大小只有小而不一致的效果,表明较小的模型足以降低计算成本。 密码和预先训练过的型号(非商业许可证): https://github.com/alexCortinaU/RT-CBCT_SSL 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02.

articles.title: Wear and Go: Calibration Free Sparse Inertial Motion Capture via Online Sensor Setup Estimation
articles.content: Sparse inertial motion capture typically assumes that each sensor's anatomical identity and mounting orientation are known. We present MOSAIC (Motion-based Sensor Assignment and Inertial Calibration), a framework that recovers this setup from ordinary motion without a calibration pose. Our central insight is that body pose changes continuously while the sensor setup persists, allowing movements that are individually ambiguous to provide complementary evidence over time. A setup network processes unordered sensor streams with temporal and cross-sensor attention, then accumulates assignment and rotation evidence into a session-level estimate. The recovered setup canonicalizes measurements for frozen pretrained pose estimators, separating sensor configuration from motion reconstruction. For sensors worn at prescribed body sites, evaluation on real inertial recordings with randomized setups shows near-calibrated pose accuracy for bounded offsets and substantial benefits from accumulation under arbitrary orientations. Transfer across pose networks supports setup recovery as a reusable interface between interchangeable sensors and pretrained pose models.

articles.title_zh: 穿戴和走:通过在线传感器设置来校正自由运动惯性捕捉
articles.content_zh: Sparse惯性运动捕捉一般假定每个传感器的解剖特征和上升方向已知. 我们提出MOSAIC(基于运动的传感器任务和惯性校正),这个框架可以从普通运动中恢复这种设置,而不用校正姿势. 我们的核心见解是,在传感器设置持续的同时,身体不断发生变化,使个别模棱两可的移动能够随着时间的推移提供补充证据。 一个设置的网络会处理无序的传感器流,同时注意时间和跨传感器,然后将任务和旋转证据积累到会话级别估计. 被恢复的设置能将被冷冻的预受训练的测量结果作为估计器,将传感器配置与运动重建区分开来. 对于在规定身体场地所穿戴的传感器,对按随机设置进行真实惯性录音的评价显示,接近校正的传感器对有限度的抵消具有精确性,并且从任意取向下的积累中获得了巨大好处。 跨姿势网络的传输支持设置回收,作为可互换传感器和被预训的姿势模型之间的可再用接口.

articles.title: RoadAnnoter: An AI-Assisted Desktop Tool for Semantic Segmentation Annotation of Road-Scene Images
articles.content: Accurate semantic segmentation of road-scene images is essential for road safety research; however, polygon-level annotation remains labor-intensive and limits labelled dataset development. This study presents RoadAnnoter v1.0, an open-source desktop application integrating six human-in-the-loop annotation modes: manual polygon delineation, SAM Prompt, Smart Select, Edge Fill, pretrained semantic segmentation using Cityscapes-trained SegFormer models, and task-specific segmentation using TinySegNet, a lightweight MobileNetV3-Small-based network trained with accumulated annotator-generated labels. SAM-based modes use promptable segmentation with SAM and MobileSAM, while Edge Fill combines Canny edge detection with colour-similarity-based flood filling in CIELAB colour space. SegFormer generates suggestions for common road-scene categories, whereas TinySegNet supports adaptation to project-specific features through iterative training. All six modes use a shared mask-to-polygon pipeline comprising morphological processing, Gaussian smoothing, contour extraction, and Douglas-Peucker simplification; annotations are exported in YOLO segmentation format. RoadAnnoter was used to annotate Google Street View images from recorded road accident locations in Bangladesh for a vision-language model-based investigation of free-flow speed estimation. Qualitative assessment across representative scenes demonstrated the complementary applicability of the annotation modes to diverse feature geometries. Visual comparison with Roboflow indicated similar qualitative boundary characteristics for principal road-scene regions, although no quantitative accuracy assessment was conducted. RoadAnnoter provides a locally operated framework for developing road-scene segmentation datasets for transportation engineering and road safety research.

articles.title_zh: RoadAnnoter:用于语义分解的AI辅助桌面工具 路景图像注释
articles.content_zh: 准确的路面图像语义分类对道路安全研究至关重要;但是,多边形层面的注释仍然是劳力密集型的,限制了标有标签的数据集开发。 本研究介绍了RoadAnnoter v1.0,一个开源桌面应用程序,整合了六个人入Loop注解模式:手动多边形划界,SAM Express, Smart Election, Edge Fill,使用Cityscapes训练的SegFormer模型进行预先训练的语义分解,以及使用TinySegNet进行任务分解,一个轻量级的MobileNetV3-Small-基于网络,训练有累积注解器生成的标签. 基于 SAM 的模式使用与 SAM 和 MobileSAM 的可快速分解,而 Edge Fill 结合了 Canny 边缘检测和 CIELAB 色彩空间中以相像为主的以相色填洪. SegFormer为常见的路面类别出谋划策,而TinySegNet则通过迭接培训支持适应具体项目的特点。 所有6种模式都使用由形态处理,高斯平滑,轮廓取出和道格拉斯-佩克简化组成的共享口罩至多面体管;注释以YOLO分解格式导出. RoadAnnoter曾用Google Street View从孟加拉国有记录的公路事故地点对图像进行注释, 代表性场景的定性评估表明,注释模式对各种地貌地貌的互补性适用。 与Roboflow的可视比较表明,主要路面区域具有类似的定性边界特征,尽管没有进行定量准确性评估。 RoadAnnoter为开发用于运输工程和道路安全研究的路面分块数据集提供了一个当地操作的框架。

articles.title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
articles.content: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.

articles.title_zh: 世界自主驾驶模式
articles.content_zh: 近期在将视觉语言-行动模型(VLA)与世界建模相结合方面取得进展,通过允许系统对所想的未来进行推理,而不仅仅是对当前观察的反应,大大推进了端到端的自主驱动. 然而,大多数世界VLA模型在像素级别上生成未来帧,并有大量密集的视觉符号. 尽管这种产生的期货可以直观地看似可信,但它们保留了许多与驱动无关的外观细节,即只有一小部分的道具直接编码了关键的规划相关因素,如代理几何,运动动态,以及相互作用等. 这引入了一个重要的性能瓶颈。 因此产生了一个重要问题:世界甚高频模型应该有什么世界状态,以支持像素水平预测以外的规划? 我们主张,面向规划的世界建模应侧重于一种紧凑而结构分明的以物剂为中心的潜伏状态,这种状态将随着时间的推移捕捉驱动场上物体之间的相互作用。 因此,我们引入了AgentWorld,一种以Agent-Centre VLA世界模型,它联合使用离散的代理符来进行推理和轨迹规划. 每个符号都动态地基于一个与其对象状态相联的周围代理人,如语义特征,3D几何,运动,和相互作用上下文等. AgentWorld通过三个关键过程来学习这些符号:明确的几何地基,以推理为导向的有监督的微调和以代理为导向的强化学习. 在各种驱动情景下广泛进行开放和闭放实验,表明AgentWorld增强规划能力,充分利用视觉证据和代理动力,并产生可解释的以代理为中心的世界国家.

articles.title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
articles.content: Whole-slide visual question answering (VQA) offers a natural-language interface to pathology, allowing diagnostic and phenotypic questions to be answered directly from tissue slides. However, current vision-language models (VLMs) rely heavily on linguistic priors: their answers are sensitive to the order of the candidate answers, and can be reached through shortcuts that bypass the tissue evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce SlideJev, a framework that separately verifies candidate answers against the slide and learns to ground these judgments in tissue evidence. To connect parallel candidate evaluation with visual evidence learning, we adopt Jev and score each candidate by the difference between support and rejection log-likelihoods from the original language-model head. We compute these scores in parallel using separate prompts with the same format and no option-position labels, then normalize them for answer selection. To ground these scores in tissue evidence, candidate-conditioned reading and comparison guide gated updates to visual tokens across decoder layers. With the backbone frozen, we train these visual modules through the same scores using question-answer and paired-image supervision. Across three whole-slide pathology VQA benchmarks, SlideJev achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and 100% answer consistency across four option orders. Image-control experiments further show that SlideJev achieves the largest average accuracy gains from correct images over mismatched and image-free inputs across the three datasets. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev.

articles.title_zh: SlideJev:全滑病理学的顺序稳定和组织组合的Jev决定
articles.content_zh: 全滑视觉问题回答(VQA)提供了一个与病理学的自然语言界面,可以直接从组织幻灯片中解答诊断和间皮问题. 然而,目前的视觉语言模型(VLMs)严重依赖语言学前言:他们的答案对候选答案的顺序很敏感,可以通过绕过组织证据的快捷方式达到. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了SlideJev,这个框架将分别验证候选人对幻灯片的回答,并学会将这些判断建立在组织证据中。 为了将平行的候选人评价与视觉证据学习联系起来,我们采纳了Jev,并根据支持和拒绝的逻辑相似性与原始语言模型头的区别来评分每个候选人. 我们同时使用相同的格式和没有选项位置标签的单独提示来计算这些分数,然后使其正常化以选择答案。 要用组织证据来证明这些分数,有候选条件的读取和比较指南将可视符号的更新门接通了解码层. 随着骨干被冻结,我们通过相同的分数来训练这些视觉模块,使用问答和配对图像监督. 在三个全滑道病理VQA基准中,SlideJev实现了最高的平均值总体准确度,在四个选项指令中100%的回答一致. 图像控制实验进一步显示,SlideJev在三套数据集的不匹配和无图像输入上,从正确图像中获得的最大平均精度收益. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev上公开查阅。

articles.title: Harnessing Image Diffusion Prior for Photo-Realistic Video Restoration
articles.content: Recent image generation models produce photo-realistic results with rich details, but transferring their powerful priors to video restoration remains difficult due to temporal inconsistency from stochastic detail synthesis. Existing video restoration methods improve temporal coherence but often sacrifice visual fidelity, leaving a gap between image-level quality and video-level stability. We propose a generative video restoration method that bridges this gap by enabling temporally consistent detail synthesis from image generation priors. Our method combines noise energy rebalancing to suppress structure-disturbing low-frequency stochasticity, motion-aligned noise warping to propagate details along object motion, a self-supervised denoising encoder to mitigate encoder-induced temporal uncertainty, and decoupled temporal attention to model cross-frame dependencies. Together, these components preserve fidelity, enhance fine-grained realism, and maintain temporal consistency. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially outperforms existing video restoration approaches in visual quality, detail richness, and temporal stability.

articles.title_zh: 利用图像传播在照片真实性视频修复之前
articles.content_zh: 近期的图像生成模型产生了具有丰富细节的相片现实主义结果,但由于从相片细节合成中产生的时间上不一致,将强大的前科转移给视频修复仍然很困难. 现有的视频修复方法提高了时间一致性,但往往牺牲视觉的忠诚,在图像质量和视频稳定性之间留下了空白. 我们提出一种基因视频修复方法,通过使图像生成前的分层细节在时间上一致的合成来弥补这一差距。 我们的方法结合了噪声能量再平衡来抑制结构扰动的低频相交错,运动相相相相相交错的噪声会随物体运动来传播细节,一个自我监督的去噪声编码器来缓解编码器引起的时间不确定性,以及解开时间对模型跨框架依赖性的关注. 这些组成部分共同维护忠诚、增强精细的现实主义并保持时间一致性。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在视觉质量、细节丰富性和时间稳定性方面大大超过了现有的视频修复方法。

articles.title: LOCUS: Causal Support Windows for Attribute Control in Autoregressive Image Generation
articles.content: Unified autoregressive (AR) image generators struggle to satisfy multiple attribute constraints in a single prompt. Although these attributes are decodable from image-token latents, editing those latents at test time remains difficult. Adding a fixed attribute direction to the prefix can reinforce a requested attribute but rarely overrides a conflicting one, such as turning a car red when the prompt specifies blue. We investigate how the effect of an intervention depends on where it acts in the image-token sequence. We introduce the causal support profile, which measures, for each attribute, how often patching image-token states within a given window flips the rendered attribute. Structural attributes (count and position) are most responsive in early, narrow windows, while appearance attributes (color, size, and material) respond over later, broader windows. A budget-matched comparison of early and middle windows shows that the effect of window location depends on the target attribute, and two-dimensional support maps show that the responsive regions track spatial content. Based on these profiles, we propose LOCUS (Latent Optimization in Causal Support windows), which diagnoses which attribute failed and routes test-time latent optimization to its corresponding support window. With the generator, optimizer, reward, verifier, and token budget held fixed, support-routed windows outperform late windows by 23.6 percentage points in GenEval++ macro accuracy. With the generator frozen, LOCUS raises Janus-Pro's GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% overall and from 19.5% to 40.5% on multi-attribute tags. On GenEval, LOCUS repairs 48.1% of failed generations in one rollout, compared with 37.4% for prefix optimization, and needs 14% fewer rounds on average to succeed.

articles.title_zh: LOCUS: 自动递归图像生成中属性控制的原因支持窗口
articles.content_zh: 统一的自递(AR)图像生成器在单个快取中拼搏来满足多个属性限制. 虽然这些属性可以从图像刻入的潜想中解码,但在测试时编辑这些潜想仍然很困难. 在前缀上添加固定的属性方向可以强化所请求的属性,但很少会凌驾于相冲突的属性上,例如当提示指定为蓝色时会将一辆车变成红色. 我们调查干预的效果如何取决于它在图像存储序列中的行动。 我们引入了因果支持配置, 用于衡量每个属性, 在特定窗口中多频繁地对图像键状态进行补丁, 翻转给定属性 。 结构属性(计数和位置)在早期,狭小的窗口中反应最快,而外观属性(颜色,大小,和材料)在后期,更宽的窗口中反应最快. 对早期和中间窗口的预算相匹配的比较表明,窗口位置的效果取决于目标属性,二维支持地图显示反应区域跟踪空间内容. 基于这些配置,我们提议LOCUS(Causal支持窗口中的Latent Optestization),该选项诊断哪些是失败的属性,并引导测试时间潜在优化到相应的支持窗口. 在GenEval++宏准确度中,由于生成器、优化器、奖励、核查器和象征性预算被固定,支持路由窗口比后期窗口高出23.6%。 随着发电机被冻结,LOCUS将Janus-Pro的GenEval++精度从24.6%整体提升到46.8%,并在多属性标签上从19.5%提升到40.5%. 在"GenEval"上,LOCUS在一次推出中修复了48.1%的失败世代,而前缀优化则需要37.4%,并且平均需要减少14%的回合才能成功.

articles.title: Beyond Co-Generation: Rethinking Jointness in Joint Audio-Video Generation
articles.content: Our aim is to advance the understanding of genuine audio-visual coordination in joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, with particular emphasis on semantic consistency. Evaluating audio-visual consistency in T2AV generation is nontrivial, as detailed text prompts obscure whether such consistency stems from genuine cross-modal coordination or merely from independent text following. To isolate the former, we introduce intrinsic jointness: the ability of audio and video to produce the same realization for details left underspecified by the prompt. Using semantically underspecified prompts (e.g., "musical instrument playing" rather than "electric guitar playing"), we investigate four recent models and reveal their limited intrinsic jointness. To address this limitation, we propose JointREPA, a simple representation alignment-based post-training method to facilitate cross-modal coordination. Since existing benchmarks use semantically detailed prompts, we introduce UNSAIDBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate intrinsic jointness under semantic underspecification. Experiments across two distinct models and three benchmarks, including UNSAIDBench, demonstrate that JointREPA consistently improves semantic consistency.

articles.title_zh: 超越同源: 反思联合视听制作
articles.content_zh: 我们的目标是在联合生成文本至音频视频(T2AV)的过程中,促进对真正视听协调的理解,并特别强调语义一致性. 评估T2AV生成中的视听一致性是非三角性的,因为详细的文本使人们不清楚这种一致性是源于真正的跨模式协调,还是仅源自后面的独立文本。 为了隔离前者,我们引入了内在的连通性:音频和视频能够产生相同的实现,而细节被快取所忽略. 使用精密的不精确的提示(例如"音乐乐器演奏"而不是"电吉他演奏"),我们调查了最近四个模型,并揭示出它们有限的内在关节. 为了克服这一限制,我们提议联合REPA,一种简单的基于代表性的调整培训后方法,以促进跨模式的协调。 由于现有基准使用详细提示,我们引入了《联合国财务条例》,该基准旨在评估语义下固有的关联性。 跨越两个不同模式和三个基准的实验,包括《联合国财务条例》,表明《联合区域环境方案》不断提高语义一致性。

articles.title: Propose & Verify: Fast Reflection Symmetry Detection via Harmonic Fields
articles.content: Detecting multiple reflection symmetries in 3D shapes requires aggregating geometric evidence over a large space of candidate planes, making traditional voting approaches computationally expensive. We introduce the Fourier Accelerated Symmetry Transform (FAST), a training-free framework that combines geometric pair voting with efficient spectral computation. Exploiting the fact that global reflection planes pass through the shape centroid, we reduce the search to plane orientations, while geometric consistency filtering and independent witnesses suppress unreliable pair hypotheses. Our key insight is to represent these votes as a signal over plane orientations and efficiently compute a continuous, smoothed symmetry field in the spherical-harmonic domain. Specifically, we exploit the Funk-Hecke theorem, the spherical counterpart of the Fourier convolution theorem for rotationally symmetric kernels, to transform Gaussian smoothing into multiplication of harmonic coefficients. This enables efficient field evaluation, from which symmetry candidates are extracted, refined, and geometrically verified. Across two benchmarks, including a new benchmark of highly symmetric shapes, FAST achieves the highest clean multi-plane detection $F_1$ scores among evaluated methods (0.861 and 0.947), with GPU inference below 4 ms per shape: over $100\times$ faster than the next-fastest evaluated multi-plane GPU baseline. FAST also demonstrates strong robustness to geometric noise and competitive single-plane detection, achieving 94.9% success on clean single-plane shapes.

articles.title_zh: 推荐验证( V) : 通过和谐场进行快速反射对称检测
articles.content_zh: 检测多反射对称的3D外形,需要将几何证据汇总到大片候选平面上,使得传统的投票方式计算成本昂贵. 我们引入了傅里叶加速对称变换(FAST),这是一个将几何对等投票与高效光谱计算相结合的无训练框架. 探索全球反射平面穿过外形中心行星的事实,我们把搜索缩小为平面取向,而几何一致性过滤和独立目击者压制不可靠的对对假说. 我们的关键洞察力是代表这些选票在平面取向上作为信号,并高效地计算出球-和声域中连续,平滑的对称场. 具体地说,我们利用了Fourier演化定理的球形对应物Funk-Hecke定理来旋转对称内核,将高斯平滑化为和声系数相乘. 这样就能够进行有效的实地评价,从中提取、改进和几何核实对称候选人。 通过两个基准,包括高度对称形状的新基准,FAST在评估方法中实现了最高的清洁多平面探测分数$F_1美元(0.861和0.947),GPU推论低于每平面4ms:超过100美元/次比下个测试评估多平面GPU基线快. FAST还表现出强烈的几何噪声和有竞争力的单平面探测,在干净的单平面外形上取得了94.9%的成功.

articles.title: CaFe: Causally Faithful Conditional Traffic Scenario Generation
articles.content: Language-conditioned traffic simulation enables scalable test scenarios steered by natural language. The goal is to control selected agents while surrounding traffic reacts to their observed behaviour. For example, a vehicle instructed to cut in late should cause the following vehicle to brake only when the manoeuvre becomes observable. Yet simulators can leak private instructions across agents, causing surrounding vehicles to react before the instructed behaviour becomes observable. Such premature reactions defuse desired events and alter the ensuing closed-loop scenario. Existing benchmarks measure what agents do, not what they could have known, leaving this failure unmeasured. We formalise it as intent leakage and address it through evaluation, data and modelling. Our paired intervention test holds an instructed agent's executed trajectory fixed while varying its private instruction, isolating leakage-induced changes in surrounding agents. We also construct WOMD-PACT, an automatically generated, verifiable dataset of 531,099 WOMD scenes with timed behaviour tags with reaction episodes identified through a counterfactual ghost test and grounded private instructions. Finally, we introduce CaFe, a dual-stream diffusion-forcing simulator fine-tuned in closed loop that restricts inter-agent interactions to public beliefs, preserving legitimate anticipation without leaking private intent. Our evaluation reveals that existing conditioning designs displace 23-83% of nearby uninstructed agents through private-intent leakage, even when the instructed agent's executed motion is held fixed. CaFe eliminates measurable leakage while maintaining comparable WOSAC realism (0.763), demonstrating that causal faithfulness can be enforced without sacrificing measured simulation realism.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CaFe: 造成信任的有条件交通情景
articles.content_zh: 语言条件交通模拟可以使自然语言所引导的可伸缩的测试情景. 目标是控制选定的物剂,而周围的交通则对其所观察到的行为作出反应. 例如,被指示迟到的车辆,只有在机动性变得可观察到时,才应使以下车辆起刹. 然而模拟器可以跨剂泄露私人指令,导致周围的车辆在指示的行为被观察到之前作出反应. 这种不成熟的反应缓解了所期望的事件并改变了随后的闭路性情况。 现有基准衡量代理人的工作,而不是他们本可以知道的,使这种失败得不到衡量。 我们把它正式确定为有意泄漏,并通过评价、数据和建模加以解决。 我们的配对干预测试 将指示剂的行走轨迹固定下来 同时改变其私人指示 隔离周围物剂的泄漏引起的变化 我们还构建了WOMD-PACT,一个自动生成,可核查的数据集,由531,099个WOMD场景组成,并带有有时间的行为标记,反应事件通过反事实幽灵测试和被禁入的私人指令被识别出. 最后,我们引入了CaFe,一种双流传播强制模拟器在闭环中进行微调,将代理者之间的相互作用限制在公共信仰中,在不泄露私人意图的情况下保持合法的预期. 我们的评价显示, 现有的调制设计 取代了23-83%的 附近无指令的代理 通过私人的渗透, 即使被指示的代理 被执行的动作被固定。 CaFe在保持可比较的WOSAC现实主义(0.763)的同时消除了可测量的渗出,表明因果的忠诚性可以在不牺牲有分量的模拟现实主义的情况下被强制.

articles.title: Keeping Parts Honest: Isolated Part Graphs for Faithful Vision Transformer Explanations
articles.content: Part and prototype-based explanations for Vision Transformers (ViTs) present a decision as evidence from individual image regions. However, self-attention mixes information across patches, so part-level features absorb context from the whole image and consequently fail to faithfully reflect the decision. We show that existing interpretable ViT classifiers depend heavily on this leakage: when each explained region is encoded in isolation, their accuracy collapses, and retraining them under isolation recovers only part of the lost accuracy. We propose a classifier that represents each image as a graph of isolated parts. Each part is encoded only from its own patches by a ViT whose last blocks are fine-tuned under isolation, preventing evidence leakage from elsewhere in the image. Parts are discovered without annotation and refined hierarchically through their sub-parts, making them more consistent and stable across images than those of competing methods. Each edge is computed from part pairs, and recovers evidence that attention previously shared across the object without affecting the parts. Matching the image graph to a learned prototype graph per class makes the prediction a direct combination of node and edge similarities, each computed only from the patches it is credited to, so every explanation is faithful by construction. Across 11 fine-grained and general-object benchmarks, our method exceeds the accuracy of existing explainable methods that rely on leakage, while providing explanations that reflect what the model actually uses.

articles.title_zh: 保持部分诚实:为忠实的愿景变革者而孤立的部分图解
articles.content_zh: 基于部分和原型的"视觉变形器"(ViTs)解释提出了决定,作为单个图像区域的证据. 然而,自觉将信息混合到整个补丁中,因此分级特性吸收了整个图像的上下文,因此无法忠实地反映决定. 我们显示,现有的可解释的ViT分类器在很大程度上依赖于这种渗漏:当每个被解释的区域被编码为孤立区域时,它们的准确性会崩溃,在隔离下再培训它们只会恢复失去的准确性的一部分. 我们提出一个代表每个图像的分类器,作为孤立部分的图. 每个部分只被一个VIT从自己的补丁中编码出,其最后的块被隔离后微调出,防止了从图像中其他地方渗出的证据. 部件在不作注释的情况下被发现,并通过子部分进行分级精炼,使其在相竞方法的图像之间更加一致和稳定. 每个边由部分对来计算,并取回以前在物体上共享的注意而不影响部分的证据. 将图像图与每个类的学习到的原型图相匹配,使得预测直接结合了节点和边缘的相似性,每个被算入的补丁都只能计算出来,所以每个解释都是通过构造而忠实的. 在11个精细和一般目标基准中,我们的方法超过了依赖渗漏的现有可解释方法的准确性,同时提供了反映模型实际使用内容的解释.

articles.title: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
articles.content: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.

articles.title: Kolibri: Color Finds the Place, Refinement Sets the Pose for RGB-D Localization in Colored Point Clouds
articles.content: An agent or robot in a scanned building must locate its camera in rooms that no model saw during training. Point cloud registration methods can align each RGB-D frame with the building's colored point cloud, accurately but at a high cost. We observe that geometric refinement brings nearby initial poses to the same final pose, so the learned component only needs to find the place. Kolibri does this with a graph network of 55,712 parameters that describes 10 cm cubes of points, called cells, by their color, local shape and neighbors. With the same refinement, it matches GeDi on 96 unseen ScanNet rooms (81.4% against 80.3% within 5 cm and 5°) and on a held-out test of 10 further rooms, in 82 ms per frame on an RTX 2080 Ti. The saved time allows for search without a room label. In one point cloud of 100 rooms, Kolibri loses 1.3 points against knowing the room, while retrieving the room first loses 56.0. In a hospital emergency department scene from a real scan, it localizes 86.5% of the frames rendered from the scan in 384 ms each, where GeDi needs 91 minutes per frame on cubes of the scan for a similar recall. The method needs colors that agree between the frame and the point cloud. On gray frames and across cameras with different color responses, point cloud registration methods keep the lead.

articles.title: A tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude open-water search and rescue
articles.content: Large aerial platforms often operate above 1.5 km to improve the efficiency of open water search and rescue (OW-SAR). However, long imaging distances, wide fields of view, and limited sensor resolution reduce objects to a few pixels, increasing their susceptibility to environmental interference and making detection harder than for conventional small objects. To our knowledge, existing datasets focus on low-altitude scenarios and do not support automatic detection at 1.5-2.0 km. We therefore present TinyWOD, a tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude OW-SAR using lifebuoys as detection targets. It comprises 11,359 manually annotated images and 19,505 annotated instances spanning diverse environments, lighting conditions, water colors, and surface ripples. Compared with existing datasets, TinyWOD contains much smaller objects and a substantially higher proportion of tiny instances; its average equivalent side length (ESL) is 12.7 pixels, with 76.96% of in stances having ESLs below 15 pixels, reflecting actual high-altitude water-rescue imaging conditions. We define APtiny, a tiny object detection metric, and benchmark mainstream and state-of-the-art networks using this and conventional metrics. All evaluated networks effectively detect tiny waterborne objects, demonstrating TinyWOD's reusability and utility. We expect this dataset to support research on tiny object detection in high-altitude OW-SAR.

articles.title_zh: 用于高空开阔水域搜索和救援的小型物体探测数据集
articles.content_zh: 大型航空平台经常运行于1.5公里以上,以提高开放取水搜救(OW-SAR)的效率. 然而,相距长的成像距离,视野宽广,传感器分辨率有限等效物会将物体降低到几像素,使其更容易受到环境干扰,使探测比常规小物体更难. 据我们所知,现有的数据集侧重于低海拔情景,不支持1.5-2.0公里的自动检测。 因此,我们提出TinyWOD,这是一个用于高空OW-SAR以活体为探测目标的小型物体探测数据集。 它包括11 359个人工说明图像和19 505个附加说明的例子,涉及不同的环境、照明条件、水的颜色和地表波纹。 相较于现有的数据集,TinyWOD包含更小的物体和相当高比例的小例;其平均等效侧长(ESL)为12.7像素,有76.96%的姿势有ESL低于15像素,反映了实际的高空取水成像条件. 我们定义了APtiny, 一个微小的物体检测指标, 以及基准主流 和最先进的网络 使用这个和传统的指标。 所有被评价的网络都有效检测出微小的水上物体,显示出了TinyWOD的可重复性和实用性. 我们期望这个数据集能支持高空OW-SAR中微小天体探测的研究.

articles.title: Pixel is All You Need
articles.content: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.

articles.title_zh: 像素是所有你需要的
articles.content_zh: 文字,图像,音频,触摸,甚至机器人行动,原则上都可以被展示到一个单一的画布上,提出一个宏大的目标,在视觉中统一所有模式. 语言提供了自然的第一测试. 要包含它,视觉模型必须直接在文字上以像素来解释. 然而,我们发现,在各种图像、视频和统一的多模式生成器中,它们的视觉生成模块不能对画布上的文字进行象征性的推理。 只有当一个基本的文本模块或即时重写已经提供了答案,有效地将生成器降为单纯的渲染器时,它们才会成功,而后训练几乎没有解决这个限制. 为了测试这种失败是来自像素本身,还是来自目前的训练范式,我们从零开始训练一个纯粹像素空间基因模型的家族,没有任何文字路径。 这些模型以图像作为唯一的输入和输出,读取问题,写出中间步骤,并在画布上直接产生答案. 值得注意的是,它们展现出大型语言模型的标志性行为. 随着权力法的制定,业绩可以预期地得到改善。 通过框架写出中间步骤框架大大超过单框架的回答,与思维链相呼应,而强化学习后培训则会进一步加强推理. 此外,共用一张画布可以让同样的模型在各种模式之间进行推理,而这种能力是只使用文字的语言模型所缺乏的。 据我们所知,这是在纯像素-空间基因模型中对这些现象的首次系统研究,没有文字符号。

articles.title: Visual Harness Scales General VLMs to Medical Images
articles.content: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.

articles.title_zh: 视觉效果将普通VLM缩放为医学图像
articles.content_zh: 我们显示,适当的视觉利用能够大大地改进一般视觉语言模型在各种医学成像任务方面的性能。 我们引入了\ours,一种医疗视觉控制装置,它为一般的VLM配备了交互式视觉工具和系统的诊断证据管理. 通过\ours,一般的VLMs交互地探索医疗图像并逐渐得到诊断证据,这些证据保存在一个无损失的内存中,供后续检索和使用. 在提交初步答复后,核查组收到了对潜在遗漏和所查明结论的可靠性的评估。 这项评估指导了进一步的图像检查和测量,然后在获得充分证据之前,通过迭代代理循环对答案进行修订。 在11项任务和4个成像模式中,我们用Qune3.8-27B改进了所有任务的业绩,在脾脏测量(63.3----98.3---)、肾脏搜索(57.5-----71.2---)和肺结核检测(0.0------28.2----)方面取得了显著进展。 高能 API 基于 VLM 与\ours 实现更高性能. 例如,GPT-6.1 索尔将肺结核检测从10.8\%提高到69.2\%,与"我们"结合,展现出更强大的模型能力与有效的医疗视觉利用的互补效益. 我们的成果突出表明了视觉利用的潜力,作为将一般的VLM推广到医学成像任务的新范例。

articles.title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
articles.content: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: NexSight:可验证的任务,用于精细精密的代理长视频理解
articles.content_zh: 关于长视频的细微问题 问一个动作发生多少次, 以什么顺序发生事件, 回答他们需要找到一个短暂的瞬间 分散在几小时的镜头中 代理模型决定了何时何地寻找希望来找到这些时刻,但这种能力既难以衡量,也难以学习。 分散的佐证证据可以证明,某项行动是在没有确定总数的情况下发生的;核实整个时间范围的索赔要求检查遗漏和重复计算。 仅以回答为主的监督又没有明确监督寻找证据。 我们提出NexSight,它构建了可核查的任务,以评价并培训对长视频的了解。 它的代理管道"SightForge"(SightForge)只有在一个对答案草稿视而不见的核查者能够从原始视频中密集地重新获得的证据中重建出来,反实例检查无法反驳的情况下,才接受一项任务. 这产生了SightLine,从108个长相视频中共出310个可追踪证据的任务,通过SightLoop来评价,这是一个支持时间探索,局部检查,证据整合的多尺度共享工具,在记录返回的观测时进行再探. 在脱节视频中,关于已核实任务的解析器轨迹成为观察决定的分级监督. 最强的模型在SightLine上只达到54.52%,然而在给出附加说明的证据时却达到79.35%. 以6K以下为例,Sight-35B几乎是其基础模型交互精度的两倍(21.29%至42.26%),优于其家族397B模型,在训练后开始使用明确空间检查,其基础模型从未使用,并在两个外部长视频基准上获得8分以上.

articles.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
articles.content: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.

articles.title_zh: 环境有限责任公司: 数据有效 通过温度匹配进行监管的微调
articles.content_zh: 为自递性语言模型收集大规模、多样和高质量的培训后数据集是一项挑战。 因此,监督的精细图解(SFT)通常被应用于比预训用得小得多的数据集,这导致数据分布尾巴的过度调整和灾难性地被遗忘. 为了防止这种倒闭,我们引入了Ambient SFT,这是一个利用不完善预测来增强微调集的原则框架. 在我们的方法中,"被冻结"的"被预先训练的"模型"版本充当了吵闹的老师,而精细的模型必须在粗糙的层面上相匹配. 特别是,我们要求训练后模式制作的有条件分发的高温版本应当与训练前的高温版本相匹配. 温度超参数计控制了对被预先训练的模型的信任程度,限制为$T\to\fty$返回到常规的SFT,而$T=1$返回到知识分馏. 我们证明,我们的做法超越了标准SFT,跨越域的适应、指示调整和推理,导致与标准SFT相比,平均高出21美元。

articles.title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
articles.content: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.

articles.title_zh: 什么比斯头测量? 头级比对归属中的不可识别性
articles.content_zh: 在大语言模型中将社会偏见定位到个人注意力头部并通过去除这些偏见的方法,通过它们对公平性衡量标准的影响得到验证,从没有证据表明选择头部的统计数据衡量了偏见。 我们对Quen-2.5-7B指令和Llama-3.1-8B指令进行审计。 头图与标签-盲式反应-长图相连接,分别为0.950美元和0.768美元,显然表明表面混乱。 断开长度标签接合的干预拒绝这个读法:在被及时扣住的固定状态下,响应长度解释了1%的统计差异. 解释它的原因,是快速身份, 以64%的差异, 在一个不是单调长度的订单中。 在任何固定的提示中,响应长度和有被保护组令牌的存在是0.95美元的连线,部分根据标签规则的定义,因此任何观察分析都不能将地图归属于其中任何一种,在这个家族中没有任何方法可以进行实验. 实质性主张独立失效:偏见的选择性不是在参考读物中任何一种模型的后期集中,我们测试过的头集都没有降低减速时的不公平率。 其补充在相反的标签上得分,可靠地摧毁了拒绝行为(p = 2.7\times10^{5}$),表明管道探测到这种规模的影响.

articles.title: Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
articles.content: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44\% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure--residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: https://github.com/haihuang-ml/structure-residual

articles.title_zh: 结构 - 语言模式预训的响应性诱导比喻
articles.content_zh: 依赖下接的预测来学习预测行为和内部表现. 我们问,代表结构本身是否应当是一种明显的诱导性偏见。 以科尔莫戈罗夫复杂性的两部分编码观点为动机,我们研究了一个结构-剩余原则,在这个原则中,一个代表将结构与实现细节区分开来. 我们以两种相辅相成的方式,即时阐述这一原则。 Birgin Botleneck Concept (BBC) 通过边界载体从符号段传输信息,同时保留了本地自递性计算. 连续概念(CC)使表达几何规范化并诱导光谱分解为低频结构和高频残基. 我们得出两种观点的编码界限,并显示,随着区内路径能量的消失,多重修正的边界注意力变得精确。 BBC和CC展现出截然不同的深度偏好: BBC在早期的分层效果最好,而CC在后期分层效果最好. 在300M训练符上,结合了BBC和CC在GPT-2 Medium上改进了1.44\%. 随着培训达到20B个标志,这些成果得以持续。 表现诊断显示BBC增加了边界状态的相对预测重要性,而CC则会减少光谱残留能. 这些结果共同表明,结构 -- -- 遗留的偏见可以改进语言模型的预训,超越下接预测。 代码:https://github.com/haihuang-ml/结构-剩余

articles.title: Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI
articles.content: We investigate how language models process negation in natural language inference (NLI). We propose the \textit{Polarity Composition Hypothesis}, a high-level causal model of this computation. Behavioral evaluations show that language-model predictions largely conform to the proposed hypothesis. Using Distributed Alignment Search, we identify causally effective subspaces aligned with the variables in the polarity-composition hypothesis. These representations transfer across negation forms and partially to a subset of MNLI. We release the dataset and code.

articles.title_zh: 极性组成假设: NLI 忽略的因果关系
articles.content_zh: 我们调查语言模型如何在自然语言推论中进行否定。 我们提出\textit{均等组成假设},这是这个计算的一个高级因果模型. 行为评价显示,语言模型预测基本符合拟议假设. 使用分布式对齐搜索,我们识别出与极分-组合假说中的变量相匹配的因果有效的子空间. 这些陈述通过否定形式转移,并部分转移到多国流动企业的子公司。 我们发布数据集和代码。

articles.title: MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
articles.content: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内政部-洛拉 多种语言适应方法:系统的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 路由低等适配器提供了一个参数效率高的手段来改善大型语言模型(LLM)跨任务的表现. 因此,据推测,这些语言也可以用来改进对LLMs中资源不足语言的支持,目前这些语言比全世界数千种其他语言的英语服务要好得多。 然而,这一假设从未在共同的多语种评价协议下经过经验验证。 我们正视这一差距,在9{}000多个评价设置中,用200种独特的语言,在一个被冻结的基模上比较了八种低等适应(LORA)方法。 我们的结果显示,缩小规模的搜索可以确定LORA方法的可行配置,但无法可靠地预测其相对性能,因为顶级配置在规模上从未达到最佳. LoRA可靠地改进了适合翻译数据的语言模式,持续地降低阅读理解度,并且对资源匮乏的语言受益最大。 这些调查结果表明,LORA方法应被视为有针对性的工具,而不是提高LLMs多语种能力的一般用途手段。

articles.title: TextSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity
articles.content: Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. We incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that jointly promotes semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate that TextSphere consistently reduces generation FID (gFID) over the text-conditioned baseline while achieving reconstruction FID (rFID) below 1.0. With only 4 and 6 sampling steps, TextSphere achieves lower gFID than the compared diffusion- and GAN-based models trained from scratch on CUB-200-2011 and MS-COCO-2014, respectively. We further observe that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily yield better generation quality. In addition, we use Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) to analyze cross-modal alignment and modality gap, offering insight into the effectiveness of our approach.

articles.title_zh: 文本层:通过共享的超球面对齐和统一生成高效文本到图像
articles.content_zh: 最近在文字到图像生成方面的进展大大提高了图像质量,特别是通过传播方法,这些方法需要多个推论步骤。 相形之下, Sphere Encoder提供了一个高效的基因框架,能够以更少的前进步骤生成图像. 然而,将其扩展至自由式文本是非三角性的,因为它的类条件设计缺乏跨模式对接. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用文本圈(TextSphere),这是一个高效的文本到图像分源框架,将Sphere Encoder扩展为语言条件和跨模式相接. 我们通过适应地层常态化(AdaLN)嵌入经过预先训练的CLIP文本来指导图像生成,同时保留了原始的球形采样机制. 为了弥合跨模式代表差距,我们提出了球形语义一致和统一的目标,共同促进超层语义一致和代表统一。 关于CUB-200-2011、MS-COCO-2014和Flickr30k的实验表明,TextSphere持续地将FID(gFID)的生成量降低于文本条件基准,同时实现重建FID(rFID)低于1.0. 由于只有4个和6个取样步骤,TextSphere的GFID低于分别从零开始在CUB-200-2011和MS-COCO-2014上培训的基于传播和GAN的模型。 我们进一步注意到,改善重建忠心不一定产生更好的发电质量。 此外,我们使用部分最不平面 Singular Value分解(PLS-SVD)来分析跨模式对接和模式差距,为我们的方法的有效性提供了深刻的见解.

articles.title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
articles.content: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.
