articles.title_zh: 注意差距:已部署的多代理文件维护系统
articles.content_zh: "AI革命"使整个技术行业的团队能够以前所未有的速度提供软件特征. 虽然代码的进取速度比任何时候都快,但客户化的文件往往难以跟上速度. 由于用户越来越多地依赖以LLM为基础的代理人,使用文件作为其主要接口,这种文件空白的影响会恶化:陈旧的信息传播,并被视为权威信息。 用于确定文件落后之处的信号已经大量存在,既包括明示的(例如,显示文件所缺乏内容的已解决的支持票),也包括默示的(例如,从自动循环中可探测出代码-文件差异)。 我们部署一个多剂系统, 围绕一个我们称之为"三剂"的分解剂, 它不断地提取这些信号和修复文件漂移。 在43天的影子模式操作中,我们的系统对499张门票进行了三分校对,并在文档中出现了92个空白. 利用独立模范家庭的LLM法官小组,三律师可核实的断言中有81.1%是正确的(302个断言中的245个是人的决议地址;3个法官的大多数);在长度相仿的对子上,三律师小组倾向于70.5%的对子和23.2%的人力工程师(其余没有法官多数)。 重要的是,代理人和人为来源的答复往往是相辅相成的,人们常常露出洞察力,这些洞察力要么埋藏在现有的文件中,要么完全从中缺失;我们的系统将每个洞会变成一个文件空白,在经过人文审查后,变成一个固定点。 修补漏洞可以衡量地改进了代理商后来的回答:当代理商在修补后重新回答同一张罚单时,失明的法官更喜欢修补后的回答,而不是自己在修补前的回答时间的71.4%(n=35). 盲目的人的审计证实了对自我改进的强烈一致。

articles.title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.

articles.title_zh: 地平线的幻想:视线-语言模型是否像理想观察者一样维吾检索文字和图像?.
articles.content_zh: 被检索到的视觉语言模型(VLM)从两个证据来源中解答,每个证据都可能失败:被检索到的文本可能错误或吵闹,图像也可能被退化或相矛盾. 我们引入了由COCO和Visual Genome所制造的GIB-200K,20万个图像问题项目,每个项目都扩展为可控的压力条件:硬负回取噪(1-20个文档),视觉模糊(Gausian and Movement 模糊,低资源收成)和与反事实翻转对对的交叉模式冲突. 我们不但要衡量退化,还要问模型如何将两种模式结合起来。 从理想的贝叶斯提示组合中,我们得出了一种可测试的预测,该预测得出了"知识内线"(相对于模型自身图像证据的文本超重)和"感官捕捉"(反相)的正式定义,我们用一个测量-过重校正的回归来估计重量,我们验证了这些回归的已知重量的恢复。 反事实翻转分解将模式偏差与概念前缀区分开来,并用地平线幻觉分数来测量图像中有多少干净的精度没有根基. 我们评价一个冷冻的4个开放式模型, 种子评价分为2 000个GIB-200K项目。 所有模型在清洁输入上都是准确的(92.5%-94.2%),但反准确率下降到41.3%-59.9%. LLaVA的两个模型超重了文本(Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229和1.322),而InternVL3偏好图像(w_T/w_I = 0.680);在文档存在时,34.8%到71.4%的正确答案被废弃. 无培训一致性检查,将答案与不检索的答案进行比较,在误导性文件下进行准确性覆盖,而当图像严重退化时,返回图像失败。 发布所有每一次输入输出,代码,以及重新计算每个已报告的开放型号的审计.

articles.title: Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue
articles.content: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.

articles.title_zh: 动态任务分配与对话
articles.content_zh: 有效的多代理人合作需要代理人随着目标和责任的演进而调整任务分配. 先前的任务分配框架常常承担静态目标,完全可观察性,或者依赖大型语言模型,对任务分配或意图没有明确,可核查的信念. 这些假设将它们的可适用性限制在现实世界的合作上,在现实世界中,代理商往往缺乏关于对方行动,进步,或当地环境的充分信息. 为了在部分可观察性下支持动态任务分配,我们采用了沟通强化的巴耶西亚任务分配框架。 我们的代理人利用对话来减少环境和合作者的不确定性,同时保持基于明确概率信念的决定。 我们在一个过于成熟的领域中评估我们的框架,在完全和部分的物体空间可观察性下,我们的任务充满活力。 我们的通讯代理在两种情况下 都比香草LLM代理强 此外,我们的框架在完全可观察性下与非交流任务分配基线相对应,但在部分可观察性下,由于任务复杂程度平均增加0.585个,平均完成18个时间步,其绩效大大高于这一基准。 这些结果表明,我们的代理人在动态任务分配方面比在部分可观测环境中的基线更有效,而且随着现有信息的减少,沟通也十分重要。

articles.title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
articles.content: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.

articles.title_zh: Nunchi:多党对话中的耳朵帮助眼睛
articles.content_zh: 确定一个人看谁对理解多党对话至关重要,然而,随着更多的人出现,仅仅看几何就变得模糊不清。 对话提供了几何学缺乏的提示,例如谁在说话和所说的话,但是没有央视数据集为许多多党派场景提供. 我们引入了SORBET,从1,578个有同步语音,文字记录的片段中取出3,340个样本的基准,以及出席的人物标签,覆盖的多党场景比现有的央视数据集还要多. 先前的凝视模型在努力使用这些以不同形式出现的提示时,必须和合适的人联系起来,并且可以与凝视几何相冲突. 我们提议Nunchi这个框架从文字记录和央视和扬声器模型的输出中构建出一个文本提示,将每个提示与候选人连接到共同的标签上,并让一个视觉语言模型(VLM)将央视几何与对话提示进行权衡,以识别受访者。 Nunchi的成绩比现有最强的方法高出4.8个百分点。 在SORBET上,对话提示有帮助,而额外视觉提示则无所助益,收益则贯穿三个VLM,并带有自动记录誊本,以及两个现有的数据集.

articles.title: Large-scale Neuron Community Discovery Reveals Neuron-Sparse Behaviors in Language Models
articles.content: What reusable units of computation can we discover within a language model's neurons? Prior work has shown that individual forward passes can often be sparsified post-hoc to small groups of neurons, but it has been unclear whether these groups form coherent computational entities reused across inputs. We introduce neuron community discovery, an unsupervised method for finding neuron groups that recur across prompts and are causally necessary and sufficient, within the layers they span, for common computations. The method combines gradient-based attribution, a graph connecting neurons that are repeatedly attributed together, and community detection. Applied to Llama-3.1-8B using ten million prompts, it discovers thousands of candidate communities. We evaluate them on held-out prompts through three causal tests: community necessity, sufficiency within a layer subset, and layer necessity. These tests identify groups whose removal disrupts predictions and whose retention preserves predictions despite ablating the remaining MLP neurons in the tested layers. Discovered communities support functions like grammatical agreement, token-probability calibration, fixed phrases, in-context copying, addition, and multiplication. With communities capped at 128 neurons across all layers, 10.3% of held-out prompts have at least one layer's contribution explained on a neuron-sparse basis. Coverage remains 8.7% when requiring at least four layers and 3.3% when requiring at least twelve. These results show that small groups of existing neurons can provide reusable computational components across prompts, and that such groups can be discovered at scale.

articles.title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
articles.content:
Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows.
  This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures.
  Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence.
  Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.

articles.title_zh: 自然语言编程:反思语言,记忆,以及基因AI时代的认知.
articles.content_zh:
遗传人工 智能正在改变自然语言在计算系统中的作用. 在古典自然语言处理(NLP)中,语言被当作一个计算对象:分析,分类,翻译,或生成的东西. 大语言模型(LLMs)挑战了这一视角,使自然语言越来越能发挥可执行的认知介质的作用,人类通过它来构建推理,协调解决问题,并规范人类/AI混合工作流程.
本文将"自然语言编程"(NLPg)作为传统"自然语言编程"(NLP)的理论和认知延伸. NLPg概念不只注重语言理解,而是催生出能将目标、限制、假设、验证标准和中间推理状态外部化的动态认知手工艺品。 因此,促动不仅仅是一种技术交互技术,而是在分布的人类/AI记忆架构中运行的一种对话认知编程形式.
论文以分布式认知,扩展心智,元认知,和对话式学习等理论为基础,提出了"对谈工作记忆"的概念,描述了即时和对话状态如何作为支持推理连续性和反射调节的临时外存结构发挥作用. 我们进一步将现有的内存结构(BTMA, SKGE, RMR)映射到这个框架上,以说明史诗,语义,和元认知层如何支持长相间的对话一致性.
最后,讨论了对计算语言学和AI/mediated知识系统的影响,提出了一种后符号化和后界面范式,自然语言在其中作为通信媒介、可执行规格、认知脚手架和分布式记忆结构同时运作。

articles.title: What's in a Tree ? Hierarchical $n$-gram models as controlled approximators of language
articles.content: Hierarchical models have been proposed as synthetic settings for studying language. However, their relevance to realistic language corpora remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce tree-grams, autoregressive generative $n$-gram models that build the conditional probability tensor $p(x_n \mid x_{1:n-1})$ through a hierarchical composition of order-2 and order-3 tensors. $n$ controls the maximal context window, whereas a rank hyperparameter $d$ controls model capacity, yielding an interpretable and systematically scalable family of approximators of language. We show how tree-grams outperform existing $n$-gram baselines, while remaining competitive with deep transformer-based language models. We demonstrate the utility of such controlled approximations by using tree-grams as generative models. In particular, we show that hyperparameter transfer under $μ$P can be made more robust when narrower models are tuned on simpler data, generated by tree-grams with moderate $n$ and $d$. In addition, we show that entropy and effective range of correlations control performance gap after fine-tuning. This is because tree-grams allow us to explicitly control horizon and capacity. When allowed to route across candidate topologies, we observe emergent sparsity in tree-grams. Such concentrated routing permits pruning upto 95\% of topologies without significant change in performance.

articles.title_zh: 树里有什么? 作为语言控制近似物的分级美元-克模型
articles.content_zh: 分级模型被提出作为研究语言的合成设置. 然而,它们与现实语言corpora的相关性仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 在这部作品中,我们引入了树克,自相递回的基因元-克模型,通过顺序2和顺序3的分级组成来构建条件概率角(x_n\mid x_{1:n-1})$p. $n$控制最大上下文窗口,而分级高参数$d$控制模型容量,产生可解释和系统可扩展的语言近似家族. 我们显示树克如何超过现有的美元-克基线,同时保持与基于深变压器的语言模型的竞争力。 我们通过使用树克作为基因模型来证明这种有控制的近似值的效用。 特别是,我们表明,如果在较简单的数据上调取更窄的模型,用中度美元和德元的树克生成的多参数调取,那么在μ$P下的超参数调取可以更加有力。 此外,我们显示,在微调后,各种关联的有效范围可以控制性能差距。 这是因为树克使我们能够明确控制地平线和能力。 当被允许穿越候选地貌时,我们用树克观察出突发的孢子. 这种集中的路由可以使高达95个的地貌,而性能没有重大变化。

articles.title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
articles.content: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理治理多种自然语言标准运行时间核查
articles.content_zh: 人工智能代理人受数百种自然语言标准的约束,但现有的核查人无法根据一大批符合、违反或不适用的标准和报告,有效地评估代理人的产出。 我们引入了 VFM, 一种树意验证器, 它编码了共享的上下文和目标文本, 并同时对 N 自然语言标准进行评分, 返回独立 的 / criterion ternary 判断 。 VFM对标准银行进行了预先培训,该银行共有394K个(背景、目标、标准、判决)拖拉子,跨越了321K个不同的标准弦。 微调后VFM-4B在合成治理基准上超过了GPT-5.4. 在Dyna Bench多标准基准上,它比DynaGuard-4B在微量级故障检测上的表现要好,它的每个标准判决将被违反的规则本地化,支持有重点地升级到一个更大的思维链法官. 我们显示,标准银行的预训改进了跨域传输,特别是在低数据系统中,同时在全数据上匹配了强大的直接微调控制. 在单H100上,VFM-4B在 <11 GB VRAM上,对2s以下的4K-token上下文评价了1000个标准,使其适合运行时间验证.

articles.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
articles.content: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决议假设: 代理 Evolution 的密钥是识别改进
articles.content_zh: 代理进化遵循一个简单的循环:求婚者会写出候选文物(即时,技能,记忆)并选择接受得分较高的文物. 这个循环显示了希望,然而实践者却面临一个谜题:方法贸易在论文之间获胜,进化过程往往无法解决某些任务。 我们把这个谜题追溯到解析假说: 代理进化的停滞不是因为方法不能提出更好的工艺品,而是因为噪音的评价无法可靠地识别出它们. 在整个7个演化方法和6个模型(超过10M LLM调用)中,我们发现在使用评价分数的两级都支持假设. 在候选(选取文物)一级,有帮助的候选文物存在,但选取并不比从有害文物中随机分辨好,因此错误会相继累积. 在方法层面(分级方法),典型的几个百分点相差小于同一方法的两个独立跑道的相差,因此所公布的排名往往取自运气. 这些调查结果表明,代理人进化往往由于可靠地确定改进而受阻。 这要求我们改变我们如何发展和评价自我改进的代理人,从设计更多的备选改进系统,到使真正的改进可以探测和累积。

articles.title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
articles.content: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预测工具:预测代理人的活、可控制和可重播基准
articles.content_zh: 代理商基于大型语言模型(LLMs),通过搜索Web和对发现的东西进行推理,越来越能预测现实世界的事件. 这种代理人的预测如何取决于所取取的证据和模型,使控制这些证据对评价至关重要。 活性评价可以在每个系统自行搜索时将检索与推理相混合,而回溯性搜索则可以通过日期过滤或今天的历史页面排名来泄露后期信息. 比较模型,搜索源和内存策略,既需要固定的证据,也需要记录它是如何在解析前演变的. 我们引入了"预测Gym"(PreatyGym),它记录了四个商业网络搜索API每两天返回一次公开预测-市场问题,并在结果得知后重放被冻结的证据,比较模型,内存,并根据固定的证据获取政策捕获搜索来源. 其首次发布的内容包括150个问题,614个证据状态,每个问题和收集时间各一个,以及131k搜索结果. 在结算返回后重放同样的查询结果,所有问题除说明结果外,不超过92%,尽管测试了日期过滤器。 在被冻结的证据上,所有经过测试的LLMs都跟踪市场预测准确性. 我们的诊断分析显示,错失的公共信息比误读更能造成高差距状态的差距。 切换搜索 API 将模型的 Brier 分数修改为 0.043 , 超过跨模型的分布,而持续音符的分数类似地重读了输入符中的一半的所有证据. 预测者看到的证据与读取它的模式一样重要.

articles.title: Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
articles.content: In the global attention layers of Gemma 4 31B, the value is the normalized key projection, and the key is the value scaled by a fixed weight, with rotary position encoding on one quarter of its dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5%, but the open serving engines that we checked still store a full key and a full value: 1,024 values per KV head and token. We store one 640-value row instead, exact in real arithmetic, and an unchanged paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views as its key cache and its value cache. In a vLLM prototype with the 16-bit 31B model, the outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, 2 of 432 final answers differ from the stock engine (within its run-to-run noise), and the steady decode KV memory per request falls by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens. On a prefill/decode pair of two A100 GPUs with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, a decode engine with a full 15 GiB pool ran 1.38 times the stock decode tokens per step for 16K-token prompts (repeated to 0.06%) and 1.24 times for 8K-token prompts; a model of the vLLM block pool predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and on this path the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype makes an eager step 4% to 9% slower at equal batch, and the method does not yet stack with an 8-bit KV cache at the default scale.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 存储 Gemma 4 K=V 缓存 一次: 精确的 Global- KV 内存节省, 装入一个无变化关注的网页服务引擎
articles.content_zh: 在Gemma 4 31B的全局关注层中,值为正态密钥投影,而键为被固定重量所缩放的值,旋转位置编码在其四分之一维度上. Gemma 4的报告指出,这种设计将全球KV缓存减少高达37.5%,但是我们所检查的开放服务引擎仍然存储着一个完整的密钥和一个完整的值:每KV头和令牌有1,024个值. 我们存储了一个640个值行, 准确的在真实的算术中, 一个不变的页式关注内核读取它 通过两个相重叠的相接的视图 作为它的密钥缓存和其值缓存。 在16位31B型的vLLM原型中,输出与股票缓存上同一算术的仿真相同,432个最终答案中有2个与股票引擎不同(在其运行到运行的噪声范围内),每个请求的稳定解码KV内存相差1.34到1.40的系数以32K到64K的令牌相差. 在两个有NIXL转接和CPU卸载的A100GPU的预装/解码对接上,一个装有全15个GiB池的解码引擎每步运行了1K-token poils的1.38倍(重复到0.06%)和1.24倍(重复到8K-token poils);一个vLLM块池的模型预测了两者的比例都在1%以内(引擎高了0.7%到0.9%)并匹配它们之间的变化. 急切地解码吞吐量上升了1.30和1.11倍,在此路径上,紧凑的引擎给出了与第1批8个出道的模拟输出符相同的输出符. 运行时原型使得在等分批时的急切步骤4%到9%的速度更慢,而该方法尚未以默认比例堆放出8位KV缓存.

articles.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
articles.content: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TPHC: 改进由 Tensor-Parallel 组合更新的超连接
articles.content_zh: Hyper-Connections(HC)将变形器的剩余流扩展为一元并列流,多节制的HC(mHC)使其规模稳定. 然而,mHC从超过4个流中得益甚微,部分原因是每个子层会为所有流写出一个单一的输出,限制了这些流的更新方式的不同. 在这项工作中,我们提出TPHC,它将拉诺-平行(TP)硬体与HC流相融合,以促进各流之间更大的独立性. 具体地说,我们把残余流的单独混合物输送到每个TP硬化后,在回写时保持单个硬化输出的分离,这样每个流就可以得到这些输出的不同混合物. 这种设计使得残流更新更能表现,而不给注意或FFN子层添加参数或FLOP. TPHC在TP下原生支持分流收缩,当两者都使用4个流时,在8B模型上只需比mHC多9%的培训时间. 培训时间从4个增加到16个,只增加了19%。 TPHC在经过100B令牌训练的1.1B模型上,将验证损失降低0.7-1.0%,并将6个常识推理基准的平均零发精度提高0.3-0.7个百分点,相对于相匹配的流数($N\in=4,8,16==$. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC上查阅。

articles.title: Large Language Models Have Not Yet Transformed Science
articles.content: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) in late 2022 has raised questions about the future of science, but assessing their impact requires understanding how scientific practices were already evolving. We analyze 2.5 million full-text papers across five disciplines from 2015 to 2025, tracing trends over a broad spectrum of lexical, structural, epistemological, and social dimensions. Aside from frequency shifts in some words, most pre-2023 trends continued with limited detectable breaks. Among the notable exceptions, growth in computer science coauthor teams accelerated significantly in Asia, while apparent declines in biomedical topic diversity largely reflected standardization in article formats. Our study establishes an empirical foundation for monitoring the health of global science as LLM adoption deepens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型还没有实现科学转型
articles.content_zh: 2022年后期出现的大型语言模型(LLMs)引起了对科学未来的质疑,但评估其影响需要了解科学实践如何已经演变. 我们分析了2015年至2025年五个学科的250万份全文论文,追踪了广义的词汇、结构、认知和社会层面的趋势。 除了某些文字的频率变化外,2023年之前的大多数趋势仍在继续,可探测到的中断有限。 在显著的例外中,亚洲计算机科学合作作者队伍的增长显著加快,而生物医学主题多样性的明显下降主要反映了文章格式的标准化。 随着LLM的采用加深,我们的研究为监测全球科学的健康建立了经验基础。

articles.title: Can Decision Models Replace LLMs in Real-World Contact Center Classification and Judging Tasks?
articles.content: Contact center systems often need to make bounded decisions, such as identifying a caller's intent, retrieving the knowledge-base article that answers a query, assessing agent compliance, or judging the output of AI models used in production. Decision models return a typed answer and its probability directly, making them a promising cost-effective alternative to generative Large Language Models (LLMs) in such bounded conversational tasks. However, their effectiveness in real-world contact center applications remains unclear. In this paper, we compare nine decision models against thirteen generative LLMs in zero-shot settings across eight contact center use cases: six classification tasks and two judging tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that many decision models can match the performance of frontier LLMs on contact center classification, and API-based closed decision models achieve this at the lowest per-request cost among the API models we evaluate. We further observe that their confident predictions are more accurate, enabling selective routing in real-world production scenarios. Across classification tasks, the main weakness of most decision models is abstention: they rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of their gap to the strongest LLMs (although Gemini-Decision-1 is the notable exception in this regard). We also find that the judging quality of decision models drops sharply for smaller models, and they are also more prone to position bias. In short, our findings provide practical guidance for selecting decision models based on abstention behavior, confidence, and deployment cost, rather than overall accuracy alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决策模型能否取代现实世界联系中心分类和判断任务中的法学硕士?
articles.content_zh: 联系中心系统往往需要做出有约束的决定,例如确定呼叫者的意图,检索回答询问的知识基础文章,评估代理遵守,或者判断生产中使用的AI模型的输出. 决策模型直接返回一个打入的答案及其概率,使它们在这种有限度的对话任务中成为有希望的成本效益的替代基因大语言模型(LLMs). 然而,它们在现实世界联系中心应用中的有效性仍不明确. 在本文中,我们比较了9个决策模型和13个零镜头环境中的遗传性LLMs在8个联系中心使用的案例:6个分类任务和2个判断任务. 我们的实验表明,许多决策模型可以匹配联系中心分类方面的前沿有限责任模型的性能,基于API的封闭决策模型以我们评价的API模型中最低的按要求成本实现这一点. 我们进一步观察到,他们的自信预测更加准确,使得在现实世界的生产情景中能够有选择的路径。 在所有分类任务中,大多数决策模式的主要弱点是弃权:它们很少选择不回答选项,这占了它们大部分差距到最强的LLMs(尽管双子座-决定1是这方面的显著例外). 我们还发现,对于较小的模型来说,决定模型的判断质量急剧下降,它们也更容易出现位置偏差。 简言之,我们的调查结果为选择基于弃权行为、信心和部署成本的决策模式提供了实际指导,而不仅仅是总体准确性。

articles.title: The Shared Word: Evaluating Language Models on Dutch Word Puzzles
articles.content: Many LLM benchmarks for languages other than English are translated, multiple-choice, or difficult to score automatically. We introduce The Shared Word (TSW-NL), a Dutch benchmark built around four core principles: it is language-specific, open-vocabulary, human-curated, and deterministically scored. Each puzzle gives three clues that describe different senses or uses of the same Dutch word. The clues are individually ambiguous, requiring the solver to combine evidence across multiple clues. We construct the benchmark from Dutch Wikipedia disambiguation pages, followed by automatic filtering and extensive manual curation. The final dataset contains 222 instances, with three independent human answers per test item. The task is clearly challenging: scores in our human study range from 49.5% to 61.0% and the highest-scoring open-weight model we tested reaches only 39.3%. Many others even score below 20%. At the same time, closed-source models show great progress: GPT-4.1 (April 2025) scores 59.2%, whereas GPT-5.6 Sol with max reasoning scores 88.8%. We believe this task provides a useful addition to Dutch model evaluation, plus a clear recipe that can be applied to construct a similar benchmark for other languages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 共享词:评价荷兰语词谜上的语言模型
articles.content_zh: 许多英语以外的语言的LLM基准被翻译,多选择,或难以自动得分. 我们引入了《共同言语》(TSW-NL),这是荷兰的一项基准,它围绕四个核心原则:语言、公开投票、人语、定分。 每个谜题都给出了三个线索来描述同名荷兰语词的不同感想或使用. 线索个别模糊不清,需要解题者将跨多条线索的证据相融合. 我们从荷兰维基百科的解析页面构建基准, 最终数据集包含222个实例,每个测试项目有三个独立的人类答案. 这项任务显然具有挑战性:我们人类研究的分数从49.5%到61.0%不等,我们测试的最高分开放量模型只达到39.3%。 还有许多人甚至得分低于20%。 同时,闭源模型显示出了巨大的进步:GPT-4.1 (2025年4月)得分59.2%,而GPT-5.6 Sol最大推理得分88.8%. 我们认为,这项任务为荷兰模式评价提供了有益的补充,并提供了可以适用于为其他语文构建类似基准的明确方法。

articles.title: When Do Typed Decision Models Work in Transportation? Evidence from Travel Choice and Traffic Signal Control
articles.content: Typed decision models combine natural-language understanding with a structured interface that returns a selected action and an option-level probability distribution without generating lengthy textual responses. Their low inference cost and response latency make them attractive for transportation problems with predefined alternatives. This paper investigates their effectiveness, robustness, and efficiency in two representative transportation tasks: individual travel-mode choice prediction and sequential traffic signal control. We systematically evaluate TypeSafe Jev and GPT-6 Luna Decisions against conventional transportation methods, reinforcement learning algorithms, and four chat-based large language models. Experiments on the Swissmetro dataset show that typed decision models achieve lower prediction accuracy than traditional discrete choice models and the strongest chat-based baseline, while their performance varies substantially with input representation and question framing. In closed-loop traffic signal control experiments, typed decision models demonstrate competitive performance against established controllers in several scenarios, but exhibit performance degradation under more challenging network conditions. Furthermore, the typed models achieve lower inference latency and computational cost than the evaluated chat-based large language models, highlighting their potential for efficient, zero-shot transportation decision-making. Overall, these findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of typed decision models, emphasizing the importance of input design, task characteristics, and robustness evaluation for their effective application in transportation systems.

articles.title_zh: 字型决策模型何时在运输中起作用? 旅行选择和交通信号控制的证据
articles.content_zh: 被打出的决定模型将自然语言理解与结构化的界面结合,在不产生长长的文字响应的情况下返回一个选定的动作和选项级概率分布. 它们的推论成本和反应延迟性低,使它们对预先确定的替代品的运输问题具有吸引力。 本文调查了这两个具有代表性的运输任务的有效性,稳健性和效率:个人出行模式选择预测和相继的交通信号控制. 我们系统评估TypeSafe Jev和GPT-6 Luna 对照常规运输方法,强化学习算法,以及四个基于聊天的大型语言模型. 在Swissmetro数据集上的实验显示,打出的决定模型的预测精度低于传统的离散选择模型和最强的以聊天为基础的基线,而其性能则在输入表示和问题设定方面有很大差异. 在闭路交通信号控制实验中,打出的决定模型显示在几种情景中相对于既定控制器的竞争性能,但在更具挑战性的网络条件下表现出性能退化. 此外,所输入的模型实现的推论延迟和计算成本低于所评价的基于聊天的大型语言模型,突出了其高效零镜头运输决策的潜力。 总的来说,这些调查结果表明,打字决策模式具有潜力和局限性,强调投入设计、任务特点和稳健性评价对于在运输系统有效应用这些模式的重要性。

articles.title: When the tail is earned by its companions: measuring label dependence in long-tailed multi-label classification
articles.content: A rare label seldom occurs alone, and a classifier can recover it from the frequent labels it co-occurs with, its companions, without having learned the label itself. Existing diagnostics of this need a trained model: none says before training whether a corpus admits the failure, or what the standard aggregate hides. Macro-F1, like any measure built from per-label confusion counts, is unchanged by how a label's recall divides between occurrences with and without a companion. We introduce a within-label estimand of that division, a reading rule under which a fall in dependence counts only if companion-free recall rises, and a statistic of training labels that bounds, before training, how far reported recall can exceed companion-free recall. Across 23 corpora, 7 training objectives and five families of label-correlation mechanisms, companion-free recall falls short on all six corpora where the estimand is defined. Up to 18.4% of the tail true positives macro-F1 credits would vanish at the companion-free rate, within the training-label bound on every corpus. No long-tail objective reduces the dependence, but architecture moves it. Models whose tail score is computed from other labels' predictions are strongly dependent.

articles.title_zh: 当尾巴由伴生获得时:在长尾多标签分类中测量标签依赖性
articles.content_zh: 难得的标签很少单独出现,分类者可以从它与同伴共同使用的频繁标签中取回,而无需了解标签本身. 现有的诊断需要训练有素的模型:在培训之前,没有人说一个实体是否承认失败,或者标准总量隐藏了什么。 Macro-F1与根据每个标签的混淆计算得出的任何度量值一样,没有改变,因为一个标签的召回如何将事件与伴星相区分。 我们提出一个标签内关于这一划分的意向,一个读取规则,根据该规则,只有在无伴侣的召回增加的情况下,依赖性下降才算数,以及培训标签统计,在培训之前,报告召回的程度可以超过无伴侣召回的程度。 整个23个团队,7个培训目标和5个家族的标签-血缘关系机制,无伴的召回能力都不及所有6个团队,这6个团队被定义为理想。 高达18.4%的尾部真阳性积分 宏-F1 将以无伴奏速率消失 在每本书的训练标签中 没有长尾目标可以减少依赖性,而建筑可以移动. 从其他标签的预测中计算出尾分的模型是高度依赖的.

articles.title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
articles.content: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.

articles.title_zh: 当通过检查时不建立补全: 编码代理中的证据解释
articles.content_zh: 编码机构的核查程序必须保存执行事实,解释其范围并履行检查义务。 我们通过合格的仓库检查、受控证据消费者和可执行工作流程来研究这些责任。 一项预期的13个任务要素研究发现,正确的报告事实不一定得出所要求的有限判决。 相反,在搁置的收据供应研究中,所有122个已交付的标签都是正确的,而16个答复误报了事实,另外11个超过授权范围。 生产维修供应成功控制,有限支持的保存故障. 在涉及31项任务的118起维修事件中,源干预将启动可达性与修复和证人生产与索赔业务分开。 寿命和资源控制划定通过验证确定的内容。 生成注释比较产生局部修复差异,但可以说明错误的解释;强而有力的普通基线、新任务和技能转让研究不能提供一致的整体优势。 这些结果说明了证据解释、适用性和已完成的行动的特点,同时限制了对一般诊断优势、技能恶化或所部署的折叠效应的声称。

articles.title: Compact and Decodable Electrocardiogram Text for Large Language Models
articles.content: When a twelve-lead electrocardiogram is written as text for a large language model, the number of tokens has to be balanced against the information lost through compression. This paper presents a deterministic encoding that writes eight independent leads as amplitude letters and exact time gaps and recovers the remaining four limb leads algebraically. The key points are selected with a cardiac-cycle-dependent tolerance, the amplitudes are parameterized by a 26-letter logarithmic codebook learned from a training set, and a 10-step tolerance schedule keeps all records within a fixed token budget. The encoding was applied to 21,388 records from the public PTB-XL database and evaluated using an exact decode-and-re-encode round trip, waveform reconstruction error, and a paired comparison of convolutional classifiers trained with 5 different seeds on signals from the original and decoded databases. All records were contained in 4,080 tokens (average: 2,866 tokens, 64.3% fewer than a per-sample transcription), and all stored lead strings were exactly reproduced. The average correlation between the decoded and reference signals was 0.982. The macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.9167 for the reference signals and 0.9157 for the decoded signals (paired difference -0.0010; 95% patient-level bootstrap interval, -0.0028 to 0.0007), within the pre-specified non-inferiority margin of -0.010; this is not a confirmatory result, because the test fold had been used during encoder development. The diagnostic content of a compact text can therefore be preserved, while the language model's ability to read the text is yet another matter.
